#==============================================================================
# ■ 生活玩法引擎：日历、存档数据、钓鱼、熟客、订单、鱼谱（设计见 docs/职业生活与武林互动设计.md）
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  构建时紧接装备特效载入，内容写在 src/game/mods/110_钓鱼与客栈.rb。
#
#  ■ 日历（按原版规则）
#    原版只有一个时间变量 158：在地图上每 200 帧（约 5 秒）加 1，满 3000 长一岁（公共事件 4）；
#    家里睡一觉（要喝一瓶女儿红，“能醉上三个月”）加 750。所以：
#      一年 3000、一季 750、一月 250、一天约 8.3（3000 ÷ 360）。
#    天数从 14 岁起算：WebLife.day = ((年龄 − 14) × 3000 + 变量158) × 360 ÷ 3000
#    季节 = 变量158 ÷ 750：0 春 1 夏 2 秋 3 冬。睡一觉正好换一季。
#
#  ■ 存档数据
#    生活玩法的数据都放在 $game_system 的一个实例变量 @web_life 里（一个 Hash），随存档一起保存：
#      :v        数据版本（以后改格式时据此迁移）
#      :fish     鱼谱 { 物品编号 => [钓到的条数, 最大的一条（两）] }
#      :skill    { fishing: 熟练度 }
#      :clients  熟客 { :jose => { favor:, shown: [给他看过的鱼] }, :cook => { favor:, done: 完成的订单数 } }
#      :order    当前订单 { client:, item:, qty:, pay:, day: 接单的日子 } 或 nil
#      :stock    鱼情 { 水域 => [0～100, 上次结算的日子] }：钓一条掉一截，过日子慢慢恢复
#      :flags    杂项开关（Symbol => true）
#    只用 Hash / Array / Integer / Symbol / String，存档导回 PC 原版也能正常读取（多出的实例变量会被忽略）。
#    地图事件的出现条件需要开关时，另用剧情开关（见 110 的编号登记）。
#==============================================================================
module WebLife
  VERSION = 1
  SEASONS = %w[春 夏 秋 冬]

  # ---- 水域
  WATERS = { pond: '南郊鱼塘', sea: '冰火岛渡口', lotus: '玉女峰花溪', stream: '西郊小溪', ice: '大雪山冰溪' }

  # ---- 鱼：物品编号 => { name:, water:, seasons:, rarity:, weight: [最小两, 最大两], price: }
  #   water   水域，见 WATERS
  #   rarity  0 常见 1 少见 2 稀有 3 难得一见
  FISH = {}
  RARITY = [60, 25, 10, 2]                       # 各档的基础权重
  RARITY_NAME = %w[常见 少见 稀有 难得一见]

  @clients = {}                                  # 熟客定义（称呼档位等），内容文件登记

  # 钓竿（防具，钓竿位）=> 效果：bite 咬钩率 +%，rare 稀罕鱼加成，keep “再等等”留住鱼的几率 +%，
  #   size 鱼的重量 +%，sea 海钓时的额外咬钩率与稀罕加成（负数表示在鱼塘反而差），fast 一次只过 1 个时辰，
  #   legend “难得一见”的鱼的权重倍数。内容文件用 WebLife.rod_effect 登记
  RODS = {}
  WEAPON_RODS = {}                               # 能当兵器的鱼竿（武器编号 => 效果），拿在手里也能钓鱼

  # 钓出来的不是鱼：[种类, 权重, 最低渔技]。种类见 junk_text
  JUNK = {
    pond:   [[:shoe, 30, 1], [:sword, 15, 1], [:page, 15, 2], [:bottle, 10, 2], [:purse, 20, 1], [:bandit, 10, 3]],
    sea:    [[:shoe, 20, 1], [:page, 10, 2], [:bottle, 20, 1], [:chest, 20, 2], [:bandit, 10, 3]],
    lotus:  [[:shoe, 20, 1], [:purse, 30, 1], [:page, 15, 2], [:bandit, 10, 3]],
    stream: [[:shoe, 25, 1], [:sword, 20, 1], [:page, 15, 2], [:purse, 15, 1]],
    ice:    [[:page, 20, 1], [:chest, 15, 2]],
  }
  JUNK_CHANCE = { pond: 12, sea: 15, lotus: 12, stream: 10, ice: 8 }   # 提竿钓上来东西时，不是鱼的几率（%）
  WATER_BANDIT = { pond: 160, lotus: 160, sea: 161 }                    # 钓上来的人：水贼 / 海盗

  # ---- 钓鱼时的小插曲：[种类, 权重, 只在这些水域（nil 为都有）, 只在这些季节（nil 为都有）]
  INTERLUDES = [
    [:rain,    10, nil, [0, 1, 2]], [:tangle, 10, nil, nil], [:chat, 10, nil, nil], [:cat, 8, [:pond, :lotus, :stream], nil],
    [:drift,    6, [:stream, :pond], nil], [:gulls, 10, [:sea], nil], [:crack, 12, [:ice], nil],
    [:lotus,   10, [:lotus], [1]],
  ]
  INTERLUDE_CHANCE = 20                          # 每一竿遇到小插曲的几率（%）
  BIRD_CHANCE = 6                                # 钓上来的鱼被水鸟叼走的几率（%）

  # 鱼情：钓上一条掉多少（按稀有程度），每过一天恢复多少。连着钓十来条就“钓怕了”，睡一觉（三个月）全恢复
  STOCK_COST = [8, 10, 14, 20]
  STOCK_JUNK = 5
  STOCK_DAILY = 4

  # 渔技称号（按渔技等级）
  TITLES = [nil, '渔童', '渔童', '渔夫', '渔夫', '老渔翁', '老渔翁', '钓叟', '钓叟', '钓圣', '钓圣']
  # 钓到鱼给的实战经验（按稀有程度）
  CATCH_EXP = [0, 10, 40, 150]
  # 钓鱼练功：拿着能当兵器的鱼竿钓到鱼时，太公钓法（武功 90）长修炼进度
  ART = 90

  # 渔技 1～10：熟练度 0、10、25、45、70、100、140、190、250、320
  SKILL_STEPS = [0, 10, 25, 45, 70, 100, 140, 190, 250, 320]

  class << self
    attr_reader :clients

    def fish(id, name:, water:, seasons: [0, 1, 2, 3], rarity: 0, weight: [4, 16], price: 30)
      FISH[id] = { id: id, name: name, water: water, seasons: seasons, rarity: rarity, weight: weight, price: price }
    end

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- 存档数据
    def data
      s = $game_system
      d = s.instance_variable_get(:@web_life)
      unless d.is_a?(Hash) && d[:v] == VERSION
        d = migrate(d)
        s.instance_variable_set(:@web_life, d)
      end
      d
    end

    def migrate(old)
      d = { v: VERSION, fish: {}, skill: { fishing: 0 }, clients: {}, order: nil, flags: {} }
      d.merge!(old.reject { |k, _| k == :v }) if old.is_a?(Hash)
      d[:v] = VERSION
      d
    end

    def flag?(k) = data[:flags][k] == true
    def set_flag(k) = (data[:flags][k] = true)

    def client(key)
      data[:clients][key] ||= { favor: 0, shown: [], done: 0 }
    end

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- 日历
    def ticks
      ($game_variables[157].to_i - 14) * 3000 + $game_variables[158].to_i
    end

    def day
      ticks * 360 / 3000
    end

    def season
      ($game_variables[158].to_i % 3000) / 750
    end

    def season_name
      SEASONS[season]
    end

    def pass_time(n)
      $game_variables[158] += n
    end

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- 钓鱼

    def rod_effect(id, **fx)
      RODS[id] = fx
    end

    # 正在用的鱼竿：拿在手里的兵器鱼竿优先，其次是钓竿位上的钓竿
    def rod_entry
      a = $game_actors[1]
      return WEAPON_RODS[a.weapon_id] if WEAPON_RODS.key?(a.weapon_id)
      id = RODS.keys.find { |i| a.armor_equiped?(i) }
      id && RODS[id]
    end

    def rod
      rod_entry ? true : nil
    end

    def weapon_rod?
      WEAPON_RODS.key?($game_actors[1].weapon_id)
    end

    def title
      TITLES[skill_level]
    end

    # 物品栏说明页里的钓竿效果（web_gear.rb 的 help_pages 调用）
    def rod_lines(id)
      fx = RODS[id] or return []
      t = []
      t << "咬钩+#{fx[:bite]}%" if fx[:bite]
      t << '一次只过1个时辰' if fx[:fast]
      t << "稀罕鱼+#{fx[:rare]}" if fx[:rare]
      t << "“再等等”不易跑+#{fx[:keep]}%" if fx[:keep]
      t << "鱼的重量+#{fx[:size]}%" if fx[:size]
      t << "海钓咬钩+#{fx[:sea]}%（鱼塘−#{fx[:sea]}%）" if fx[:sea]
      t << "难得一见的鱼×#{fx[:legend]}" if fx[:legend]
      ["【钓竿】#{t.empty? ? '普通' : t.join('，')}"]
    end

    def rod_fx(key)
      (rod_entry || {})[key].to_i
    end

    def at_sea?
      @water == :sea
    end

    def skill
      data[:skill][:fishing].to_i
    end

    def skill_level
      SKILL_STEPS.count { |n| skill >= n }
    end

    def bite_chance(bait)
      sea = rod_fx(:sea) * (at_sea? ? 1 : -1)
      mood = (raining? ? 20 : 0) + (@gulls ? 25 : 0) + (@lotus_mood ? 10 : 0)
      base = [45 + skill_level * 3 + (bait ? 10 : 0) + rod_fx(:bite) + sea + mood, 95].min
      water = @water || :pond
      (base * (0.25 + 0.75 * stock(water) / 100.0)).to_i      # 鱼情差时咬钩少
    end

    # ---- 鱼情
    def stock(water)
      st = (data[:stock] ||= {})
      v, last = st[water] || [100, day]
      v = [v + (day - last) * STOCK_DAILY, 100].min
      st[water] = [v, day]
      v
    end

    def drain_stock(water, n)
      v = stock(water)
      data[:stock][water] = [[v - n, 0].max, day]
    end

    NO_BITE = { pond: '过了很久也没有鱼上钩，你一收钓竿，到树荫下歇着去了。', sea: '潮水涨了又退，一条鱼也没咬钩。',
                lotus: '花溪里静悄悄的，浮子一动不动。', stream: '溪水哗哗地流，鱼钩上的饵早被冲没了。',
                ice: '冰窟窿里的水慢慢结了一层薄冰，一条鱼也没来。' }

    def no_bite_text
      w = @water || :pond
      return "#{water_name(w)}的鱼都被你钓怕了，半天没有动静。换个地方，或者过些日子再来吧。" if stock(w) < 30
      NO_BITE[w]
    end

    def candidates(water)
      FISH.values.select { |f| f[:water] == water && f[:seasons].include?(season) }
    end

    def water_name(water)
      WATERS[water]
    end

    # ---- 小插曲（下竿时抽，影响这一竿；下雨管一天）
    def raining?
      (@rain_until || -1) >= ticks
    end

    def roll_interlude(water)
      @interlude = nil
      return nil if rand(100) >= INTERLUDE_CHANCE
      pool = INTERLUDES.select { |_, _, ws, ss| (ws.nil? || ws.include?(water)) && (ss.nil? || ss.include?(season)) }
      pool = pool.reject { |k, *| k == :rain && raining? }
      r = rand(pool.sum { |_, w, *| w })
      pool.each do |k, w, *|
        next unless (r -= w) < 0
        @interlude = k
        @rain_until = ticks + 8 if k == :rain        # 下一天都算下雨
        @gulls = k == :gulls
        @lotus_mood = k == :lotus
        return k
      end
      nil
    end

    def interlude?
      !@interlude.nil?
    end

    def interlude
      @interlude
    end

    def interlude_cat?
      @interlude == :cat
    end

    # 小插曲的文字和效果（事件里 c.say 调用一次）
    def interlude_text
      case @interlude
      when :rain
        '天上飘起了小雨，水面泛起一圈圈涟漪——下雨天，鱼最爱咬钩。'
      when :tangle
        pass_time(2)
        '钓线缠在水草上，费了半天劲才解开，日头都偏西了。'
      when :chat
        if rand(2) == 0 && respond_to?(:bottle_text)
          t = bottle_text
          t.start_with?('纸条') ? "一个过路的樵夫在你旁边坐下歇脚，闲聊了几句：#{t.sub(/\A纸条上歪歪扭扭写着：/, '')}" : "一个过路的樵夫在你旁边坐下歇脚，看了会儿你钓鱼，又走了。"
        else
          "一个过路的老汉蹲下来看你钓鱼：“#{respond_to?(:jose_tip) ? jose_tip : '这季节的鱼可不好钓啊。'}”"
        end
      when :drift
        g = 50 + rand(150)
        $game_party.gain_gold(g)
        "上游漂下来一只木盆，你伸竿把它勾到岸边，盆底竟压着#{g}两碎银子。"
      when :gulls
        '一群海鸥在不远处的海面上盘旋俯冲——那下面准有鱼群！'
      when :crack
        a = $game_actors[1]
        lost = [a.maxhp / 10, a.hp - 1].min
        a.hp -= lost if lost > 0
        '脚下的冰面“咔嚓”一声裂开一道缝，你一个趔趄，半条腿浸进了冰水里，冻得直哆嗦。'
      when :lotus
        '溪边的野花开了一大片，风一吹，花香扑鼻。你心里一静，浮子也看得格外清楚。'
      when :cat
        '一只瘦巴巴的野猫蹲在你脚边，眼巴巴地盯着你的鱼篓。'
      else ''
      end
    end

    # 喂猫：给一条最便宜的鱼，道德 +1
    def feed_cat
      id = FISH.values.select { |f| $game_party.item_number(f[:id]) > 0 }.min_by { |f| f[:price] }&.dig(:id)
      return '你的鱼篓里空空的，野猫失望地走了。' unless id
      $game_party.lose_item(id, 1)
      WebMod.gain_morality(1)
      "你丢给它一条#{FISH[id][:name]}。野猫叼着鱼，冲你“喵”了一声，钻进草丛不见了。"
    end

    # 这一季这片水里没有鱼（冰溪只有冬天能钓）
    def off_season_text
      @water == :ice ? '溪水又急又冷，鱼都躲在深处。等冬天冰封了，凿个冰窟窿才好钓。' : '这个时节，这里好像钓不到什么鱼。'
    end

    # 抽一条鱼。bait 用了香饵；patient 浮子动了以后“再等等”（稀有的更多，但可能跑掉，由事件判定）
    def roll(water, bait: false, patient: false)
      pool = candidates(water)
      return nil if pool.empty?
      sea = rod_fx(:sea) * (water == :sea ? 1 : -1) / 2
      boost = [rod_fx(:rare) + sea + skill_level + (bait ? 6 : 0) + (patient ? 8 : 0), 0].max
      weights = pool.map do |f|
        w = RARITY[f[:rarity]]
        w += boost * f[:rarity] * (f[:rarity] == 3 ? 0.4 : 1.5)
        w *= [rod_fx(:legend), 1].max if f[:rarity] == 3
        w = w / 2.0 if f[:rarity] == 0 && patient
        [f, w]
      end
      r = rand * weights.sum { |_, w| w }
      weights.each { |f, w| return f if (r -= w) < 0 }
      weights[-1][0]
    end

    # 钓上来了：记进鱼谱，涨熟练度。返回 [鱼, 重量（两）]
    def land(f)
      lo, hi = f[:weight]
      wt = (lo + rand(hi - lo + 1)) * (100 + rod_fx(:size)) / 100
      rec = (data[:fish][f[:id]] ||= [0, 0])
      rec[0] += 1
      rec[1] = [rec[1], wt].max
      data[:skill][:fishing] += 1 + f[:rarity] * 2
      drain_stock(f[:water], STOCK_COST[f[:rarity]])
      WebMod.gain_exp(CATCH_EXP[f[:rarity]]) if CATCH_EXP[f[:rarity]] > 0
      practice(1 + f[:rarity])
      [f, wt]
    end

    def weight_text(liang)
      jin, l = liang.divmod(16)
      jin > 0 ? (l > 0 ? "#{jin}斤#{l}两" : "#{jin}斤") : "#{l}两"
    end

    # 事件里用：抽鱼并写好对话要用的变量（9 鱼的物品编号，0 为没抽到）和文字
    def cast(water, bait: false, patient: false)
      f = roll(water, bait: bait, patient: patient)
      $game_variables[9] = f ? f[:id] : 0
      @last = f
    end

    # 钓上来了却被水鸟叼走（只在 land_and_text 里判定一次）
    def bird_steal?
      @bird = rand(100) < BIRD_CHANCE
    end

    def landed_text
      f = @last or return ''
      _, wt = land(f)
      return "钓上来一条#{f[:name]}——一只水鸟俯冲下来，一口叼走了！你只来得及看清它足有#{weight_text(wt)}。" if @bird
      big = data[:fish][f[:id]][1] == wt && data[:fish][f[:id]][0] > 1 ? '（比以前钓到的都大！）' : ''
      exp = CATCH_EXP[f[:rarity]] > 0 ? "（实战经验+#{CATCH_EXP[f[:rarity]]}）" : ''
      @last_text = "钓到了一条#{f[:name]}，足有#{weight_text(wt)}！#{big}#{exp}#{practice_note}"
    end

    # ---- 钓鱼练功：规则与原版向师傅学武相同——每次加（读书识字÷10＋悟性＋加成）÷2 的修炼进度，
    #      满（等级＋1）² 升一级，升级前要过原版的经验上限检查（ckeck_exp_maxlv）。只是不花潜能
    def practice(times)
      @leveled = nil
      return unless weapon_rod?
      @leveled = train(ART, times)
    end

    def practice_note
      @leveled ? "一甩一收之间，你对太公钓法又有了新的领悟！（太公钓法升到#{@leveled}级）" : ''
    end

    # 边干活边练功（钓鱼练太公钓法、砍柴练攀山步）：规则同原版向师傅学武——每次加（读书识字÷10＋悟性＋加成）÷2
    # 的修炼进度，满（等级＋1）² 升一级，升级前过原版的经验上限检查。没学过（0 级）不长。返回升到的等级或 nil
    def train(art, times)
      return nil unless $game_variables[art].to_i > 0
      pv = WebSkill.point_var(art)
      agi = ($game_variables[48] / 10 + $game_variables[13] + $game_variables[93]) / 2
      $game_variables[pv] += [agi, 1].max * times
      up = nil
      while $game_variables[pv] >= ($game_variables[art] + 1)**2 + 1 && ckeck_exp_maxlv(art)
        $game_variables[pv] -= ($game_variables[art] + 1)**2 + 1
        $game_variables[art] += 1
        up = $game_variables[art]
      end
      up
    end

    # ---- 钓出来的不是鱼
    def junk_roll(water)
      return nil unless rand(100) < JUNK_CHANCE[water]
      pool = JUNK[water].select { |_, _, lv| skill_level >= lv }
      r = rand(pool.sum { |_, w, _| w })
      pool.each { |k, w, _| return k if (r -= w) < 0 }
      nil
    end

    # 事件里用：变量 9 = 3 钓上来东西（junk_text 发放），4 钓上来一个水贼 / 海盗（要打一架）
    def junk_text
      data[:skill][:fishing] += 1
      drain_stock(@water || :pond, STOCK_JUNK)
      case @junk
      when :shoe   then $game_party.gain_armor(39, 1); '钓上来一只湿漉漉的草鞋……也许还能穿？（得到草鞋）'
      when :sword  then $game_party.gain_weapon(20, 1); '钓线沉甸甸的——竟是一把锈迹斑斑的铁剑！（得到铁剑）'
      when :page   then $game_party.gain_item(26, 1); '钩上挂着一页泡得发软的纸，上面画着人形和经脉。（得到武学残页）'
      when :bottle then $game_party.gain_item(41, 1); '钓上来一只封着口的瓶子，里面卷着一张纸条。（得到漂流瓶）'
      when :purse
        g = 50 + rand(250); $game_party.gain_gold(g); "钓上来一个烂了一半的钱袋，里面还有#{g}两银子！"
      when :chest
        g = 300 + rand(700); $game_party.gain_gold(g); "钓上来一只长满藤壶的小木箱，撬开一看，是#{g}两银子！"
      else '……'
      end
    end


    def caught?(id)
      (data[:fish][id] || [0])[0] > 0
    end

    def species_caught
      FISH.keys.count { |id| caught?(id) }
    end

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- 订单（客栈收鱼）
    def order
      data[:order]
    end

    # 按钓到过的鱼出单；当季有的优先。数量和报价看稀有程度
    def new_order(client)
      known = FISH.values.select { |f| caught?(f[:id]) }
      return nil if known.empty?
      now = known.select { |f| f[:seasons].include?(season) }
      f = (now.empty? ? known : now).sample
      qty = [5, 3, 2, 1][f[:rarity]] + rand(2)
      pay = (f[:price] * qty * (1.5 + rand * 0.5)).to_i
      data[:order] = { client: client, item: f[:id], qty: qty, pay: pay, day: day }
    end

    def order_text
      o = order or return ''
      "收#{FISH[o[:item]][:name]}#{o[:qty]}条，付#{o[:pay]}两"
    end

    def order_ready?
      o = order
      o && $game_party.item_number(o[:item]) >= o[:qty]
    end

    def finish_order
      o = order or return
      $game_party.lose_item(o[:item], o[:qty])
      $game_party.gain_gold(o[:pay])
      c = client(o[:client])
      c[:done] += 1
      c[:favor] += 1
      data[:order] = nil
    end

    def cancel_order
      data[:order] = nil
    end
  end
end

#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 鱼谱画面：各种鱼的产地、季节、条数、最大一条；没钓到过的显示“？？？”
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Scene_FishBook
  def main
    @page = 0
    @waters = WebLife::WATERS.keys
    @window = Window_Base.new(0, 0, 640, 480)
    @window.contents = Bitmap.new(608, 448)
    refresh
    Graphics.transition
    loop do
      Graphics.update
      Input.update
      break if Input.trigger?(Input::B) || Input.trigger?(Input::C)
      if Input.trigger?(Input::RIGHT) || Input.trigger?(Input::LEFT)
        @page = (@page + (Input.trigger?(Input::RIGHT) ? 1 : -1)) % @waters.size
        $game_system.se_play($data_system.cursor_se)
        refresh
      end
    end
    $game_system.se_play($data_system.cancel_se)
    $scene = Scene_Map.new
    Graphics.freeze
    @window.dispose
  end

  # 一页一处水域：鱼名、季节、稀有程度、条数、最大一条；没钓到的显示“？？？”
  def refresh
    c = @window.contents
    c.clear
    c.font.color.set(0, 0, 0)
    l = WebLife
    water = @waters[@page]
    c.font.size = 22
    c.draw_text(0, 0, 608, 28, "鱼谱　#{l.title || '新手'}（渔技#{l.skill_level}级）　已钓到#{l.species_caught}/#{l.data_size_fish}种　当前#{l.season_name}季", 1)
    c.font.size = 20
    c.draw_text(0, 40, 608, 28, "← #{l.water_name(water)}（#{@page + 1}/#{@waters.size}）　鱼情#{l.stock(water)} →", 1)
    c.font.size = 18

#==============================================================================
# ■ 厨子：菜谱、做菜判定、吃饭增益（内容在 src/game/mods/130_厨子.rb）
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  做菜：备齐食材，在灶台上选“火候”（文火 / 武火 / 先武后文）和“调味”（清淡 / 咸鲜 / 重口）。
#    两样都对 → 极品（出两份），对一样 → 好，都不对 → 普通；厨艺越高，越有机会往上提一档。
#    每道菜的讲究写在菜谱提示里（“鳜鱼肉嫩，火大了就老”），要琢磨，不是背答案。
#  吃菜：填饱肚子，并在接下来的几场战斗里带上这道菜的增益（接装备特效引擎，同一时间只算最后吃的一道）。
#  存档数据：@web_life[:cook] = { recipes: [菜的物品编号], meal: [菜, 剩几场] }，熟练度在 [:skill][:cooking]
#==============================================================================
module WebLife
  HEATS  = %w[文火 武火 先武后文]
  TASTES = %w[清淡 咸鲜 重口]
  RECIPES = {}
  COOK_TITLES = [nil, '学徒', '学徒', '帮厨', '帮厨', '掌勺', '掌勺', '大厨', '大厨', '御厨', '御厨']
  COOK_STEPS = [0, 8, 20, 36, 56, 80, 110, 145, 185, 230]
  QUALITY = %w[普通 好 极品]

  class << self
    # 登记一道菜：id 是做出来的菜（物品）；needs { 食材物品编号 => 数量 }；heat / taste 是 HEATS / TASTES 的下标；
    # fx 是吃了以后的增益（装备特效写法），battles 管几场战斗；fill 填多少肚子
    def recipe(id, name:, needs:, heat:, taste:, hint:, fx:, battles: 2, fill: 200, spicy: false)
      RECIPES[id] = { id: id, name: name, needs: needs, heat: heat, taste: taste, hint: hint,
                      fx: fx.map { |t, o| (o || {}).merge(type: t) }, battles: battles, fill: fill, spicy: spicy }
    end

    def cook_data
      data[:cook] ||= { recipes: [], meal: nil }
    end

    def known?(id) = cook_data[:recipes].include?(id)

    # 学会菜谱，返回新学会的菜名（都会了返回空串）
    def learn(*ids)
      new = ids.reject { |id| known?(id) }
      cook_data[:recipes].concat(new)
      new.map { |id| RECIPES[id][:name] }.join('、')
    end

    def cook_skill = data[:skill][:cooking].to_i
    def cook_level = COOK_STEPS.count { |n| cook_skill >= n }
    def cook_title = COOK_TITLES[cook_level]

    def can_cook?(id)
      RECIPES[id][:needs].all? { |item, n| $game_party.item_number(item) >= n }
    end

    def needs_text(id)
      RECIPES[id][:needs].map { |item, n| "#{$data_items[item].name}×#{n}（有#{$game_party.item_number(item)}）" }.join('、')
    end

    # 做一道菜：返回 [品质 0～2, 份数, 说明]
    # （不叫 cook：110 里 WebLife.cook 是客栈厨师这位熟客的数据）
    def cook_dish(id, heat, taste)
      r = RECIPES[id]
      r[:needs].each { |item, n| $game_party.lose_item(item, n) }
      q = (heat == r[:heat] ? 1 : 0) + (taste == r[:taste] ? 1 : 0)
      q += 1 if q < 2 && rand(100) < cook_level * 4             # 厨艺高，偶尔有神来之笔
      portions = q == 2 ? 2 : 1
      $game_party.gain_item(id, portions)
      data[:skill][:cooking] = cook_skill + 1 + q
      pass_time(2)
      tips = []
      tips << "火候#{heat == r[:heat] ? '正好' : '不太对'}" 
      tips << "味道#{taste == r[:taste] ? '正好' : '不太对'}"
      [q, portions, "#{r[:name]}做好了！成色：#{QUALITY[q]}（#{tips.join('，')}），得到#{portions}份。"]
    end

    # ---- 吃饭增益：最后吃的一道菜，管几场战斗
    def eat_dish(id)
      r = RECIPES[id]
      $game_variables[15] += r[:fill] if $game_variables[15] < $game_variables[16]
      cook_data[:meal] = [id, r[:battles]]
      "#{r[:name]}下肚，浑身舒坦。（接下来#{r[:battles]}场战斗：#{r[:fx].map { |e| WebGear.describe(e) }.join('，')}）"
    end

    def meal_effects
      m = cook_data[:meal] rescue nil
      return [] unless m && m[1].to_i > 0 && RECIPES[m[0]]
      RECIPES[m[0]][:fx]
    end

    def meal_battle_done
      m = cook_data[:meal]
      return unless m
      m[1] -= 1
      cook_data[:meal] = nil if m[1] <= 0
    end
  end
end

# 吃饭增益接到装备特效：战斗中当作多穿了一件带这些特效的装备
module WebGear
  class << self
    alias __life_active active
    def active
      list = __life_active
      meal = WebLife.meal_effects rescue []
      meal.empty? ? list : list + meal.select { |e| met?(e[:when]) }
    end
  end
end

class Scene_Battle
  alias __life_battle_end battle_end
  def battle_end(result)
    WebLife.meal_battle_done rescue nil
    __life_battle_end(result)
  end
end

#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 做菜画面：左边菜谱（缺料的变灰），上方显示食材与讲究；选菜后依次选火候、调味
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
module WebLife
  # 按字数拆行；标点不放在行首，挂到上一行末尾（同 WebMod 的查看描述）
  def self.wrap_lines(text, width)
    lines = []
    text.each_char do |ch|
      lines << +'' if lines.empty? || (lines[-1].size >= width && !WebMod::Builder::NO_LINE_START.include?(ch))
      lines[-1] << ch
    end
    lines
  end
end

class Scene_Cook
  def main
    @help = Window_Help.new
    @ids = ids
    @list = Window_Command.new(240, @ids.empty? ? [empty_text] : @ids.map { |id| label(id) })
    @list.y = 64
    @list.height = 416                              # 菜少时也占满一列，不留黑底
    @ids.each_with_index { |id, i| @list.disable_item(i) unless can?(id) }
    @info = Window_Base.new(240, 64, 400, 416)
    @info.contents = Bitmap.new(368, 384)
    @heat = Window_Command.new(160, options1)
    @taste = Window_Command.new(160, options2)
    [@heat, @taste].each { |w| w.x = 320; w.y = 240; w.visible = w.active = false; w.z = 200 }
    @step = :list
    refresh_info
    Graphics.transition
    until $scene != self
      Graphics.update
      Input.update
      update
    end
    Graphics.freeze
    [@help, @list, @info, @heat, @taste].each(&:dispose)
  end

  def current
    @ids[@list.index]
  end

  # ---- 下面几个方法是灶台专用的内容；药炉（160_郎中.rb 的 Scene_Brew）继承这个画面，换掉它们
  def ids = WebLife.cook_data[:recipes].sort
  def label(id) = WebLife::RECIPES[id][:name]
  def can?(id) = WebLife.can_cook?(id)
  def empty_text = '（还不会做菜）'
  def options1 = WebLife::HEATS
  def options2 = WebLife::TASTES
  def prompt1 = '火候：文火、武火，还是先武后文？'
  def prompt2 = '调味：清淡、咸鲜，还是重口？'
  def make(id, a, b) = WebLife.cook_dish(id, a, b)

  def refresh_info
    c = @info.contents
    c.clear
    c.font.color.set(0, 0, 0)
    c.font.size = 20
    draw_info(c)
  end

  def draw_info(c)
    l = WebLife
    c.draw_text(0, 0, 368, 28, "灶台　厨艺：#{l.cook_title || '新手'}（#{l.cook_level}级）")
    meal = l.cook_data[:meal]
    c.font.size = 16
    c.draw_text(0, 30, 368, 22, meal ? "正在管用：#{l::RECIPES[meal[0]][:name]}（还剩#{meal[1]}场）" : '（还没吃过有增益的菜）')
    id = current or return @help.set_text('先去跟厨师学几道菜吧。')
    r = l::RECIPES[id]
    c.font.size = 18
    y = 64
    wrap = lambda do |text|
      WebLife.wrap_lines(text, 19).each { |line| c.draw_text(0, y, 368, 24, line); y += 24 }
    end
    wrap.call("食材：#{l.needs_text(id)}")
    y += 6
    wrap.call("讲究：#{r[:hint]}")
    y += 6
    wrap.call("吃了：#{r[:fx].map { |e| WebGear.describe(e) }.join('，')}（#{r[:battles]}场战斗）")
    @help.set_text(l.can_cook?(id) ? "#{r[:name]}：按确定开始做" : "#{r[:name]}：食材不够")
  end

  def update
    case @step
    when :list
      @list.update
      refresh_info if @last_index != @list.index && (@last_index = @list.index)
      if Input.trigger?(Input::B)
        $game_system.se_play($data_system.cancel_se)
        $scene = Scene_Map.new
      elsif Input.trigger?(Input::C)
        if current && can?(current)
          $game_system.se_play($data_system.decision_se)
          @step = :heat
          @list.active = false
          @heat.visible = @heat.active = true
          @heat.index = 0
          @help.set_text(prompt1)
        else
          $game_system.se_play($data_system.buzzer_se)
        end
      end
    when :heat
      @heat.update
      if Input.trigger?(Input::B)
        back_to_list
      elsif Input.trigger?(Input::C)
        $game_system.se_play($data_system.decision_se)
        @step = :taste
        @heat.active = false
        @taste.visible = @taste.active = true
        @taste.index = 0
        @help.set_text(prompt2)
      end
    when :taste
      @taste.update
      if Input.trigger?(Input::B)
        @taste.visible = @taste.active = false
        @heat.active = true
        @step = :heat
      elsif Input.trigger?(Input::C)
        q, _, text = make(current, @heat.index, @taste.index)
        $game_system.se_play(q == 2 ? $data_system.shop_se : $data_system.decision_se)
        back_to_list
        @help.set_text(text)
        @ids.each_with_index { |id, i| can?(id) ? @list.able_item(i) : @list.disable_item(i) }
        refresh_info_keep_help
      end
    end
  end

  def refresh_info_keep_help
    t = @help.instance_variable_get(:@text)
    refresh_info
    @help.set_text(t)
  end

  def back_to_list
    @heat.visible = @heat.active = false
    @taste.visible = @taste.active = false
    @list.active = true
    @step = :list
    refresh_info
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ■ 逍遥派武功：小无相功（内功 78）
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  无相：本身没有招式，却能催动天下各派绝招。
#
#  观招：启用小无相功（内功栏）时，对手在战斗中使出任何绝招，你都会默记下来（永久保存）。
#  化用：启用时，记下的绝招出现在你的绝招列表里，不看原版的使用条件（不需要对方门派的武功），
#        若本身已满足原版条件（例如天下无狗不要求内功），就按原版规则使用、原价扣内力；
#        只看内力。威力按“模仿度”：使用时把这招相关武功的等级临时视为“小无相功等级 × 模仿度”。
#  现学现用：本场战斗里对手刚使出的绝招，可以免费回敬一次（不耗内力）。
#        每场可免费回敬的次数 = 1 + 等级 ÷ 100。内力不够时也能用：使用时临时借足内力。
#  模仿度 = 50% + 等级 ÷ 10 %，最高 100%。平时化用耗内力 = 原耗 × 模仿度。
#  记忆上限 = 1 + 等级 ÷ 50 招，记满时选择忘掉哪一招（或不记这一招）。
#  境界：100 级“无相反照”：对手用你记得的绝招打你时，有 等级 ÷ 10 %（最多 50%）几率被化解；
#        200 级“万法归宗”：化用的内力消耗减半。
#  打坐时内力修为的上限由启用内功的等级决定（原版规则），所以练小无相功本身就在扩充内力。
#
#  获取：平安镇西郊篱笆外石桌上的“珍珑棋局”（致敬《天龙八部》虚竹破局得逍遥派传承）。
#        选对“自填一眼”（先舍后得）即得“无相残卷”。读残卷与原版秘籍规则相同：要识字，
#        只有没拜师或逍遥派能读，读后成为逍遥派，最高学到 150 级，再往上靠练功。
#        提示：棋局旁刻着“置之死地而后生”，西郊流氓头也会说起那局怪棋。
#
#  编号：武功 / 变量 78（学习点数 138）；变量 241～252 依次存记下的绝招编号（0 为空）；
#        物品 24 无相残卷；公共事件 26 使用-无相残卷；逍遥派秘籍 6；开关 106 珍珑棋局已破
#==============================================================================
WebSkill.add_skill 78, WebSkill::INNER, 45
WebMod.variable_name 78, '小无相功'

module WebXwx
  SKILL   = 78
  SLOTS   = (241..252).to_a
  EXCLUDE = [26, 27]               # 左右互搏是系统内部用的绝招，不观、不化用

  module_function

  def level
    $game_variables[SKILL].to_i
  end

  def active?
    level > 0 && $game_variables[32] == SKILL
  end

  # 模仿度：50% 起，每 10 级 +1%，最高 100%
  def mimic
    [0.5 + level / 1000.0, 1.0].min
  end

  def capacity
    [1 + level / 50, SLOTS.size].min
  end

  def memory
    SLOTS.map { |v| $game_variables[v].to_i }.reject(&:zero?)
  end

  def memory=(list)
    SLOTS.each_with_index { |v, i| $game_variables[v] = list[i] || 0 }
  end

  def remember?(id)
    memory.include?(id)
  end

  # ---- 本场战斗的状态（不存档）
  def battle_start
    @seen = []
    @free_ids = []
    @free_left = 1 + level / 100
  end

  def seen
    @seen ||= []
  end

  def free?(id)
    active? && (@free_ids || []).include?(id) && (@free_left || 0) > 0
  end

  def use_free(id)
    @free_ids.delete(id)
    @free_left -= 1
  end

  # 是否满足原版的使用条件（与 103 skill_check 相同的判断）。满足时按原版规则用，不算化用
  def meets_requirements?(id)
    reqs = WebSkill.requirements_of(id)
    !reqs.empty? && reqs.all? { |v, val| v < 38 ? $game_variables[v] == val : $game_variables[v] >= val }
  end

  # 化用：启用小无相功，记得或本场看过这一招，且不满足原版的使用条件
  def borrowed?(battler, id)
    battler.is_a?(Game_Actor) && active? && (remember?(id) || seen.include?(id)) && !meets_requirements?(id)
  end

  def name_of(id)
    $data_skills[id] ? $data_skills[id].name : "绝招#{id}"
  end

  def say(window, text, frames = 40)
    window.draw_words(text)
    frames.times { Graphics.update }
  end

  # ---- 观招：对手使出绝招之后调用
  def observe(battler, skill, window)
    return unless battler.is_a?(Game_Enemy) && active?
    id = skill.id
    return if EXCLUDE.include?(id)
    unless seen.include?(id)
      seen << id
      @free_ids << id
    end
    if remember?(id)
      say(window, "你以小无相功看破了「#{name_of(id)}」，可以原样奉还！")
    elsif memory.size < capacity
      self.memory = memory + [id]
      say(window, "你以小无相功默记下了「#{name_of(id)}」的运功法门！")
    else
      forget = choose_forget(id, window)
      if forget
        self.memory = memory - [forget] + [id]
        say(window, "你忘掉了「#{name_of(forget)}」，默记下了「#{name_of(id)}」的运功法门！")
      else
        say(window, "你看破了「#{name_of(id)}」，但没有记下它。本场仍可原样奉还。")
      end
    end
  end

  # 记满时让玩家选择忘掉哪一招；返回要忘掉的绝招编号，nil 表示不记新招
  def choose_forget(id, window)
    window.draw_words("小无相功只能记 #{capacity} 招，忘掉哪一招来记「#{name_of(id)}」？")
    list = memory
    cmd = Window_Command.new(260, list.map { |k| name_of(k) } + ['不记这一招'])
    cmd.x = 640 - 260 - 16
    cmd.y = [352 - cmd.height, 0].max
    cmd.z = 1000
    result = nil
    loop do
      Graphics.update
      Input.update
      cmd.update
      if Input.trigger?(Input::C)
        $game_system.se_play($data_system.decision_se)
        result = cmd.index < list.size ? list[cmd.index] : nil
        break
      elsif Input.trigger?(Input::B)
        $game_system.se_play($data_system.cancel_se)
        break
      end
    end
    cmd.dispose
    result
  end

  # ---- 化用：使用借来的绝招时，临时把相关武功提到“小无相功等级 × 模仿度”，并借足内力
  def boost(user, skill)
    return nil unless borrowed?(user, skill.id)
    eff = [(level * mimic).to_i, 1].max
    saved = { vars: {}, sp_delta: 0 }
    WebSkill.requirements_of(skill.id).each do |v, val|
      saved[:vars][v] ||= $game_variables[v]
      $game_variables[v] = v < 38 ? val : [$game_variables[v], eff].max
    end
    need = (skill.sp_cost * mimic).round
    if user.sp < need
      saved[:sp_delta] = need - user.sp
      user.instance_variable_set(:@sp, need)       # 绕过内力上限，借足内力（原版效果按内力比拼）
    end
    saved
  end

  def restore(user, saved)
    saved[:vars].each { |v, val| $game_variables[v] = val }
    user.instance_variable_set(:@sp, [user.sp - saved[:sp_delta], 0].max) if saved[:sp_delta] > 0
  end

  # ---- 100 级 无相反照：对手用你记得的绝招打你时，有几率化解
  def reflect?(user, target, skill)
    user.is_a?(Game_Enemy) && target.is_a?(Game_Actor) && active? && level >= 100 &&
      remember?(skill.id) && rand(100) < [level / 10, 50].min
  end

  def reflect(user, target, skill, window)
    words = get_skill_words(user, target, skill.id)
    say(window, words[0], 21) if words
    $dis_id2 = 100
    target.damage = 'Miss'
    $defend_text = "你以小无相功使出同一招「#{skill.name}」，将这一招化解于无形！"
    true
  end
end

  class << self
    alias __xwx_sp_cost sp_cost
    def sp_cost(battler, skill_id)
      c = __xwx_sp_cost(battler, skill_id)
      return c unless WebXwx.borrowed?(battler, skill_id)
      return 0 if WebXwx.free?(skill_id)
      c = (c * WebXwx.mimic).round
      c /= 2 if WebXwx.level >= 200                 # 万法归宗
      c
    end

    alias __xwx_consume_sp consume_sp
    def consume_sp(battler, skill_id)
      if WebXwx.borrowed?(battler, skill_id) && WebXwx.free?(skill_id)
        WebXwx.use_free(skill_id)
        return 0
      end
      __xwx_consume_sp(battler, skill_id)
    end

    alias __xwx_requirements_for requirements_for
    def requirements_for(id, original)
      return [] if WebXwx.borrowed?($game_party.actors[0], id)
      __xwx_requirements_for(id, original)
    end
  end

module WebZhemei
  SKILL = 61

  # [最低等级, 描述, 威力, 命中修正, 伤害类型, 特效]
  # 伤害类型：3 钝击，4 内劲掌力，5 抓伤（见 010 Data_Hit）
  MOVES = [
    [0,   '%{user}使出天山折梅手第一路「折梅」，五指轻拂，似折梅枝，拂向%{objector}的%{sp}', 25, 30, 4, :xieli],
    [0,   '%{user}一招「拂柳」，手掌斜斜拂出，掌风如柳，掠向%{objector}的%{sp}', 25, 30, 4, :fuxue],
    [10,  '%{user}一招「扣腕」，反手一扣一拿，直取%{objector}的手腕', 35, 32, 5, :qinna],
    [20,  '%{user}掌缘斜切，一招「穿云」，直穿%{objector}中宫，取其%{sp}', 45, 30, 4, :pofang],
    [35,  '%{user}身随掌走，一招「踏雪」，脚下不停，向%{objector}的%{sp}连拍三掌', 60, 30, 3, :taxue],
    [50,  '%{user}六掌连环，一招「六阳」，掌心隐隐发热，按向%{objector}的%{sp}', 80, 32, 4, :fenyuan],
    [80,  '%{user}一手化作六手，一招「梅影重重」，虚虚实实罩向%{objector}', 100, 34, 4, :meiying],
    [120, '%{user}掌力一吐，一招「天山雪落」，寒气彻骨，如雪花漫天压向%{objector}', 130, 35, 4, :hanqi],
  ]

  module_function

  def level
    $game_variables[SKILL].to_i
  end

  # 越博越强：小无相功记下的招数
  def bonus
    1.0 + 0.08 * WebXwx.memory.size
  end

  # 化入：记下的绝招所属的拳脚武功（使用条件里“启用拳脚”那一项）
  def borrowed_families
    WebXwx.memory.flat_map { |pid| WebSkill.requirements_of(pid).select { |v, _| v == 29 }.map { |_, sk| sk } }.uniq - [SKILL]
  end

  def pool(own, original)
    list = own.dup
    if WebXwx.active? && original
      borrowed_families.each { |sk| list.concat((original[sk] || []).map(&:dup)) }
    end
    k = bonus
    list.map { |m| m = m.dup; m[2] = (m[2] * k).round; m }
  end

  # ---- 命中后的招式特效（只对玩家出手生效）
  def after_hit(attacker, target, move)
    return unless attacker.is_a?(Game_Actor) && target.is_a?(Game_Enemy)
    return unless target.damage.is_a?(Integer) && target.damage > 0
    effect = move && move[5]
    note = effect ? apply(effect, attacker, target) : nil
    note = [note, chase(attacker, target)].compact.join if $game_variables[29] == SKILL
    $defend_text = "#{$defend_text}#{note}" if note && !note.empty?
  end

  def extra_damage(target, ratio)
    extra = (target.damage * ratio).to_i
    return 0 if extra <= 0
    target.hp -= extra
    target.damage += extra
    extra
  end

  def apply(effect, attacker, target)
    lv = level
    case effect
    when :xieli                                      # 卸力：对方下一招伤害 -20%
      target.instance_variable_set(:@zm_soften, true)
      '（卸力：对方下一招力道减弱）'
    when :fuxue                                      # 拂穴：对方闪避下降
      $npc_data[25] = $npc_data[25].to_i - [lv / 5, 5].max
      '（拂穴：对方身法迟滞）'
    when :qinna                                      # 擒拿：几率夺下兵器（同原版落英缤纷，兵器归你）
      w = $npc_data[9].to_i
      if w != 0 && rand(100) < [10 + lv / 10, 40].min
        $game_party.gain_weapon(w, 1)
        $npc_data[9] = 0
        "（擒拿：夺下了对方的#{$data_weapons[w].name}！）"
      end
    when :pofang                                     # 破防：这一下多 30% 伤害
      extra_damage(target, 0.3) > 0 ? '（破防）' : nil
    when :taxue                                      # 连拍：三掌合计约 1.6 倍
      extra_damage(target, 0.6) > 0 ? '（连拍三掌）' : nil
    when :fenyuan                                    # 焚元：烧掉对方内力
      target.sp = [target.sp - target.damage / 2, 0].max
      '（焚元：对方内力受损）'
    when :meiying                                    # 虚招：对方下一招必定落空
      target.instance_variable_set(:@zm_feint, true)
      '（虚招：对方下一招将扑空）'
    when :hanqi                                      # 寒气：几率冻住（木鸡3）
      if rand(100) < 25
        target.add_state(1)
        '（寒气：对方被冻住了！）'
      end
    end
  end

  # 30 级“折梅”：几率追加一击，威力为这一击的一半
  def chase(attacker, target)
    lv = level
    return nil if lv < 30 || target.hp <= 0 || rand(100) >= [lv / 10, 30].min
    extra_damage(target, 0.5) > 0 ? '（折梅：顺势又是一掌）' : nil
  end

  # ---- 对方出手时：卸力减伤、虚招落空
  def before_enemy_attack(attacker, target)
    return false unless attacker.is_a?(Game_Enemy) && attacker.instance_variable_get(:@zm_feint)
    attacker.instance_variable_set(:@zm_feint, false)
    target.damage = 'Miss'
    $defend_text = "那不过是一道梅影，#{attacker.name}扑了个空！"
    true
  end

  def after_enemy_attack(attacker, target)
    return unless attacker.is_a?(Game_Enemy) && attacker.instance_variable_get(:@zm_soften)
    attacker.instance_variable_set(:@zm_soften, false)
    return unless target.damage.is_a?(Integer) && target.damage > 0
    cut = target.damage / 5
    target.hp += cut
    target.damage -= cut
  end

  # ---- 生死符：对方每次行动前发作
  def plant(user, target)
    turns = 3 + level / 40
    target.instance_variable_set(:@zm_shengsi, turns)
  end

  def flare(battler, window)
    left = battler.instance_variable_get(:@zm_shengsi).to_i
    return if left <= 0 || battler.hp <= 0
    battler.instance_variable_set(:@zm_shengsi, left - 1)
    dmg = [[level, 30].max, battler.hp - 1].min      # 生死符折磨人，但不致死
    battler.hp -= dmg if dmg > 0
    stun = rand(100) < 30
    battler.add_state(1) if stun
    text = "#{battler.name}体内的生死符发作，奇痒难当，气血损失#{[dmg, 0].max}点"
    text += '，浑身发颤，动弹不得！' if stun
    window.draw_words(text)
    40.times { Graphics.update }
  end
end

  # WebEquip.weapon 38, '雁翎刀', :刀, 32, 1200, '……', dex: 1, fx: [[:chase, chance: 15]]
  def weapon(id, name, kind, atk, price, text, str: 0, dex: 0, fx: [])
    base, like = WEAPON_KIND.fetch(kind)
    WebMod.weapon id, like: like, **CLEAR.merge(name: name, atk: atk, price: price,
                  str_plus: str, dex_plus: dex, description: text)
    WebSkill.weapon_type base, [id]
    fx.each { |type, opts| WebGear.effect :weapon, id, type, **(opts || {}) }
  end

  def armor(id, name, part, pdef, price, text, str: 0, dex: 0, fx: [])
    WebMod.armor id, like: 24, **CLEAR.merge(auto_state_id: 0, name: name, kind: ARMOR_KIND.fetch(part),
                 pdef: pdef, price: price, str_plus: str, dex_plus: dex, description: text)
    fx.each { |type, opts| WebGear.effect :armor, id, type, **(opts || {}) }
  end
end

class << WebXwx
  alias __gear_mimic mimic
  def mimic
    [__gear_mimic + WebGear.value(:xwx_mimic), 1.0].min
  end
end

class << WebZhemei
  def chase(attacker, target)
    lv = level
    chance = [lv / 10, 30].min + WebGear.value(:zhemei_chase).to_i
    return nil if lv < 30 || target.hp <= 0 || rand(100) >= chance
    extra_damage(target, 0.5) > 0 ? '（折梅：顺势又是一掌）' : nil
  end
end

module WebJianghu
  module_function

  # 骰子摊：能不能看出庄家出千（敏捷天赋越高越容易），带着灌铅骰子的胜算
  def sharp_eyes?
    rand(100) < 15 + [$game_variables[12] - 20, 0].max * 5
  end

  def dice_win?
    rand(100) < (WebGear.value(:dice) > 0 ? 70 : 42)
  end

  # 赏金猎人开的价：每桩案子五百两
  def bounty
    [$game_variables[164], 1].max * 500
  end
end

bandit = lambda do |c, enemy, toll, loot, share, exp, pot|
  pay = lambda do
    c.if_gold(toll) do
      c.gold(-toll)
      c.text '山贼掂了掂钱袋，嘿嘿一笑，让开了路。'
    end.else do
      c.script '$game_party.lose_gold($game_party.gold)'
      c.text '山贼把你从头搜到脚，只摸出几个铜板，啐了一口：“穷鬼，滚吧！”'
    end
  end
  fight = lambda do
    c.fight(enemy, loot: loot,
      win: lambda {
        c.reward exp: exp, pot: pot
        c.variable(162, 1, 1) if enemy == 146         # 打败山贼头目的次数（黑风寨，见 080）
        c.if_good { c.variable(163, 1, 1) }            # 行侠次数（捕头相邀，见 080）
      },
      killed: -> { c.text '为民除害，路过的乡亲们都松了口气。'; c.reward morality: 2 },
      spared: -> { c.text '山贼磕头如捣蒜，连滚带爬地逃进了林子。' },
      escape: -> { c.text '你拔腿就跑，身后传来一阵哄笑。' },
      lose: -> { c.script '$game_party.lose_gold($game_party.gold/2)'; c.text '山贼搜走了你身上一半的银子，扬长而去。' })
  end
  c.if_good do
    c.choices(%w[破财消灾 拔刀相向]) { |i| i == 0 ? pay.call : fight.call }
  end.else do
    c.choices(%w[破财消灾 拔刀相向 入伙分赃]) do |i|
      case i
      when 0 then pay.call
      when 1 then fight.call
      when 2
        c.text '山贼上下打量你：“哟，也是道上的？前头有支商队，干完这一票，见者有份！”'
        c.text '你跟着他们劫了一支商队，分到一大包银子。'
        c.gold(share)
        c.reward morality: -5, wanted: 1
      end
    end
  end
end

      c.text '你盯着骰盅看了几把，发觉庄家袖口里藏着东西——这骰子灌了铅！'

# ■ 正邪分支：血衣楼（设计见 docs/内容设计思路.md 2.2）
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  血衣楼是一个暗杀组织：黑风寨是它在外面的爪牙，追杀温青的是它（染血书信落款的“黑风”就是它的暗号），

#
#  正道（六扇门）  20 血衣案：周捕头请你查案（道德 ≥ 96 或入了六扇门；有染血书信的多一段）
#                  22 血衣楼杀手：打赢掉血衣令残片，集齐 3 片拼出分舵位置（大地图西南的黑松林）

#                  五指山：截住血衣楼主 → 六扇门金牌，结局称号“天下名捕”
#  邪道（血衣楼）  21 血衣楼的请帖：杀一个镖头纳投名状（道德 < 160 或入伙黑风寨）
#                  24 暗杀委托：杀满 3 个目标，官府震怒
#                  25 六扇门总捕：打退总捕，楼主召你回分舵
#                  分舵：挑战楼主取而代之 → 血衣、血莲，结局称号“血衣楼主”；之后山贼见你就进贡
#  独行            两边的邀请都拒绝（道德在中间的两边都会来请）
#                  26 两头不讨好：两边轮番来找麻烦，打退 5 次
#                  27 独行侠：客栈的独行大侠来访 → 孤云佩，结局称号“独来独往”
#
#  编号：开关 142 正道 143 邪道 144 独行 145 主线完成 146 分舵已现 147/148 拒绝过正道 / 邪道 149 楼主去了五指山
#        变量 164 通缉值（作恶时增加，赏金猎人看它）165 主线阶段 166 计数（委托次数、独行打退次数）
#        敌人 154～159  物品 27 血衣令残片  防具 103～106  地图 52 血衣楼分舵
#==============================================================================
module WebRoute
  WANTED, STAGE, COUNT = 164, 165, 166
  GOOD, EVIL, ALONE, DONE, DEN, DECL_GOOD, DECL_EVIL, LORD = 142, 143, 144, 145, 146, 147, 148, 149
  START_EXP = 300_000
  TITLES = { good: '天下名捕', evil: '血衣楼主', alone: '独来独往' }

  module_function

  def sw(id) = $game_switches[id] == true
  def stage = $game_variables[STAGE].to_i
  def count = $game_variables[COUNT].to_i

  def route
    return :good if sw(GOOD)
    return :evil if sw(EVIL)
    return :alone if sw(ALONE)
    nil
  end

  def ready?
    route.nil? && $game_variables[19] >= START_EXP
  end

  def good_invite?
    ready? && !sw(DECL_GOOD) && !sw(119) && ($game_variables[160] >= 96 || sw(117))
  end

  def evil_invite?
    ready? && !sw(DECL_EVIL) && !sw(117) && ($game_variables[160] < 160 || sw(119))
  end

  # 拒绝一边的邀请；另一边也请不到你了（拒绝过，或者道德不合）时就走上独行
  def decline(side)
    $game_switches[side == :good ? DECL_GOOD : DECL_EVIL] = true
    $game_switches[ALONE] = true unless good_invite? || evil_invite?
  end

  # 邪道线被六扇门总捕追捕期间，赏金猎人不出现（总捕替代了他们）
  def hunted?
    route == :evil && stage == 2
  end

  # 镇上的人怕你：血衣楼主，或者通缉很重
  def feared?
    (route == :evil && sw(DONE)) || $game_variables[WANTED] >= 5
  end

  def hero?
    route == :good && sw(DONE)
  end

  # 结局称号（089 Scene_Finish）：走完一条路线时用路线称号
  def title_index(i)
    return i unless sw(DONE) && route
    $end_com.index(TITLES[route]) || i
  end
end
$end_com.push(*WebRoute::TITLES.values) unless $end_com.include?(WebRoute::TITLES[:good])   # 结局称号，接在原版 11 个后面

#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 钓鱼的过程（两处水域共用）
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
module WebLife
  class << self
    # 下竿：用不用香饵，咬不咬钩（变量 9：1 咬钩 0 没咬）
    # 下竿：变量 9 = 1 咬钩 0 没咬 5 这一季这里没鱼。先抽小插曲（下雨、海鸥等会影响这一竿的咬钩）
    def start_cast(water, bait)
      @water = water
      @gulls = @lotus_mood = false
      @interlude = nil
      if candidates(water).empty?
        $game_variables[9] = 5
        return
      end
      @bait = bait && $game_party.item_number(39) > 0
      $game_party.lose_item(39, 1) if @bait
      roll_interlude(water)
      $game_variables[9] = @interlude != :tangle && rand(100) < bite_chance(@bait) ? 1 : 0
    end

    # 提竿或再等等（变量 9：2 钓上来鱼 3 钓上来别的东西 4 钓上来一个水贼 / 海盗 0 跑了）
    def hook(patient)
      keep = patient ? 45 + skill_level * 3 + rod_fx(:keep) : 85 + skill_level
      if rand(100) < keep
        @junk = patient ? nil : junk_roll(@water)        # 耐心等来的一定是鱼
        if @junk
          $game_variables[9] = @junk == :bandit ? 4 : 3
          return
        end
        cast(@water, bait: @bait, patient: patient)
        $game_variables[9] = @last ? 2 : 0
      else
        @last = nil
        $game_variables[9] = 0
      end
    end

    def land_and_text
      f = @last or return '……'
      stolen = bird_steal?
      text = landed_text
      $game_party.gain_item(f[:id], 1) unless stolen
      text
    end

    def escape_text
      ['鱼线一松，鱼跑了。', '一个大家伙挣断了鱼线，跑了！', '钩子空空的，饵也被吃光了。'].sample
    end
  end
end

#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 熟客：荷西
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
module WebLife
  JOSE_TIERS = [[0, '客官'], [2, :young], [5, '渔友'], [8, '钓神']]

  class << self
    def jose = client(:jose)

    def jose_tier
      JOSE_TIERS.count { |n, _| jose[:favor] >= n } - 1
    end

    def jose_title
      t = JOSE_TIERS[jose_tier][1]
      t == :young ? ($gender == '女' ? '小姑娘' : '小兄弟') : t
    end

    def jose_greeting
      case jose_tier
      when 0 then '你也喜欢钓鱼吗？南郊有个鱼塘，冰火岛渡口能钓海鱼，听说西郊的小溪、玉女峰的花溪也有鱼！'
      when 1 then "#{jose_title}来啦！最近又钓着什么了？"
      when 2 then "哟，#{jose_title}！快坐，正想跟你聊聊鱼呢。"
      else "#{jose_title}大驾光临！今儿个想去哪儿下竿？"
      end
    end

    # 当季的提示：说一种这个季节能钓到、你还没钓到过的鱼
    def jose_tip
      todo = FISH.values.select { |f| f[:seasons].include?(season) && f[:seasons].size < 4 && !caught?(f[:id]) }
      return "这#{season_name}天啊，鱼塘里鲫鱼鲤鱼最多。想钓稀罕的，就得有耐心，浮子沉了别急着提竿。" if todo.empty?
      f = todo.sample
      "#{season_name}天正是#{f[:name]}的时候，去#{water_name(f[:water])}碰碰运气吧！"
    end

    # 给荷西看鱼：每种他没见过的鱼加一点交情，付一点“看鱼钱”
    def show_jose
      have = FISH.keys.select { |id| $game_party.item_number(id) > 0 }
      if have.empty?
        @jose_gifts = []
        return '你身上一条鱼也没有啊。钓到了拿来给我瞧瞧！'
      end
      new = have.reject { |id| jose[:shown].include?(id) }
      if new.empty?
        @jose_gifts = []
        return '这些我都见过啦。钓到没见过的，记得拿来给我瞧瞧！'
      end
      before = jose_tier
      new.each { |id| jose[:shown] << id; jose[:favor] += 1 }
      pay = new.sum { |id| FISH[id][:price] / 2 }
      $game_party.gain_gold(pay)
      names = new.map { |id| FISH[id][:name] }.join('、')
      @jose_gifts = ((before + 1)..jose_tier).to_a     # 一次跨过几档，礼物依次都给
      "#{names}！我还是头一回见！这#{pay}两银子你拿着，算我看鱼的钱。"
    end

    def jose_gift?
      !(@jose_gifts || []).empty?
    end

    # 事件里发放的钓竿（107 斑竹，112 龙须），发完清掉
    def jose_rod
      r = @jose_rod
      @jose_rod = nil
      r
    end

    # 十二种鱼都给荷西看过：送龙须钓竿（只一次）
    def dragon_rod_due?
      jose[:shown].size >= FISH.size && !flag?(:dragon_rod)
    end

    # 交情升档时的礼物（每次取一档）
    def jose_gift_text
      tier = (@jose_gifts || []).shift
      case tier
      when 1
        set_flag(:cook_intro)
        "#{jose_title}，客栈的胖厨子一直想收新鲜鱼，我跟他提过你了，你去找他吧。"
      when 2
        $game_party.gain_item(39, 10)
        "#{jose_title}，这是我秘制的香饵，挂在钩上，稀罕的鱼也忍不住。往后在我这儿也买得到。（得到香饵十个）"
      when 3
        @jose_rod = 107
        "#{jose_title}！这根斑竹钓竿跟了我二十年，今天送给你，往后的鱼就靠你钓啦！（得到斑竹钓竿）"
      else ''
      end
    end
  end
end

#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 客栈厨师：收鱼订单；交完三单挂出菜牌
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
module WebLife
  class << self
    def cook = client(:cook)

    # 订单：入行做菜以后，一半是收菜（130_厨子.rb 的 new_dish_order）
    def cook_offer_text
      dish = respond_to?(:dish_order?) && dish_order?
      (dish ? new_dish_order : new_order(:cook)) || (kitchen? && !cook_data[:recipes].empty? && new_dish_order)
      o = order or return '……'
      name = $data_items[o[:item]].name
      if o[:dish]
        "有位客人点名要吃#{name}，你能做#{o[:qty]}份送来吗？我付你#{o[:pay]}两。"
      else
        first = cook[:done] == 0 ? '荷西说你钓鱼是把好手。' : '又得麻烦你了。'
        "#{first}能不能给我送#{name}#{o[:qty]}条？我付你#{o[:pay]}两。"
      end
    end

    def cook_wait_text
      o = order
      have = $game_party.item_number(o[:item])
      unit = o[:dish] ? '份' : o[:wood] ? '根' : '条'
      "#{$data_items[o[:item]].name}#{o[:qty]}#{unit}，你身上有#{have}#{unit}。不急，慢慢来。"
    end

    def cook_done_text
      o = order
      unit = o[:dish] ? '份' : o[:wood] ? '根' : '条'
      text = "#{$data_items[o[:item]].name}#{o[:qty]}#{unit}，一#{unit}不少！这是#{o[:pay]}两，你点点。"
      (cook[:served] ||= []) << o[:item] unless o[:wood] || (cook[:served] ||= []).include?(o[:item])      # 木柴不上菜牌
      cook[:dishes] = (cook[:dishes] || 0) + 1 if o[:dish]
      finish_order
      text
    end

    def menu_ready?
      cook[:done] >= 3
    end

    def menu_text
      served = cook[:served] || []
      made = served.reject { |id| FISH[id] }.map { |id| $data_items[id].name }          # 你做的菜
      fish = served.select { |id| FISH[id] }.map { |id| FISH[id][:name] }
      dishes = (made + fish.zip(%w[清蒸 红烧 糖醋 干煎]).map { |n, way| "#{way}#{n}" }).first(5)
      who = $game_actors[1].name.to_s.empty? ? '你' : $game_actors[1].name
      "墙上挂着新写的菜牌：#{dishes.join('、')}……下面一行小字：鲜鱼由#{who}供应。"
    end
  end
end

  def self.bottle_text
    todo = RUMORS.select { |sw, cond, _| !$game_switches[sw] && (eval(cond) rescue false) }
    if respond_to?(:kitchen?) && kitchen? && !known?(63) && rand(100) < 25        # 130_厨子.rb：八宝鱼翅的方子

    end
    return '纸条被海水泡烂了，一个字也看不清。' if todo.empty?
    sw, _, text = todo.sample
    $game_switches[sw] = true
    "纸条上歪歪扭扭写着：#{text}"
  end

  def self.eat(kind, name = '金鲤')
    a = $game_actors[1]
    $game_variables[15] = [$game_variables[15] + 250, $game_variables[16]].max if $game_variables[15] < $game_variables[16]
    if kind == :gold

    else
      heal = [a.maxhp / 2, a.maxhp - a.hp].min
      a.hp += heal
      "鲜美无比！吃完浑身是劲。（气血回复#{heal}）"
    end
  end
end

#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 菜谱来源与熟客独行大侠
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
module WebLife
  class << self
    def kitchen? = flag?(:kitchen)

    # ---- 厨师：交满三单鱼后教家常菜、借灶台；交过两单菜后再教两道
    def kitchen_offer_due?
      !kitchen? && cook[:done] >= 3
    end

    def open_kitchen
      set_flag(:kitchen)
      names = learn(52, 53, 54, 55)
      "厨师把围裙一解：“你天天给我送鱼，不如我教你几手！”他教会了你#{names}。“后厨那口锅，你随时来用。”"
    end

    def cook_advanced_due?
      kitchen? && (cook[:dishes] || 0) >= 2 && !known?(57)
    end

    def cook_advanced
      names = learn(57, 62)
      "“你这手艺，可以学点难的了。”厨师又教了你#{names}。"
    end

    # ---- 荷西：入行后教海鲜
    def jose_recipes_due?
      kitchen? && !flag?(:jose_recipes)
    end

    def jose_recipes
      set_flag(:jose_recipes)
      names = learn(58, 59, 60)
      "听说你在客栈学做菜了？我们老家靠海，我教你几道海鲜！（学会了#{names}）"
    end

    # ---- 订单也收菜（入行后一半是菜，报酬更高；独行大侠介绍朋友后再高三成）
    def dish_order?
      kitchen? && !cook_data[:recipes].empty? && rand(2) == 0
    end

    def new_dish_order
      id = cook_data[:recipes].sample
      qty = 1 + rand(2)
      rate = flag?(:sword_friends) ? 2.1 : 1.6
      data[:order] = { client: :cook, item: id, qty: qty, pay: ($data_items[id].price * qty * rate).to_i, day: day, dish: true }
    end

    # ---- 熟客：独行大侠
    def sword
      client(:sword)
    end

    SWORD_CALL = [[0, '店家'], [2, :young], [5, :close]]
    def sword_call
      f = sword[:favor]
      t = SWORD_CALL.select { |n, _| f >= n }.last[1]
      case t
      when :young then $gender == '女' ? '小姑娘' : '小兄弟'
      when :close then $gender == '女' ? '妹子' : '老弟'
      else t
      end
    end

    # 他这次想吃什么（不吃辣：他带回香料时说过，以后从不点辣的）
    def sword_want
      return sword[:want] if sword[:want] && known?(sword[:want])
      pool = cook_data[:recipes].reject { |id| RECIPES[id][:spicy] }
      sword[:want] = pool.sample
    end

    def sword_back?
      sword[:away] && day >= sword[:away]
    end

    def sword_line
      if sword_back? && !flag?(:spice)
        set_flag(:spice)
        sword[:away] = nil
        $game_party.gain_item(64, 3)
        names = learn(56, 61)
        return "#{sword_call}，我回来了！西域的香料，给你带了一包——孜然辣子，那边的人顿顿离不了。" \
               "我自己可不吃辣，你记着。（得到西域香料三份，学会了#{names}）"
      end
      return "过些日子我要出趟远门，等我回来。" if sword[:away]
      w = sword_want or return "#{sword_call}也学做菜了？学会了做给我尝尝。"
      prefix = flag?(:spice) ? '老规矩，不要辣。' : ''
      "#{sword_call}，#{prefix}今天想吃#{RECIPES[w][:name]}，有吗？"
    end

    def sword_can_serve?
      !sword[:away] && (w = sword_want) && $game_party.item_number(w) > 0
    end

    def serve_sword
      w = sword_want
      $game_party.lose_item(w, 1)
      pay = ($data_items[w].price * 1.5).to_i
      $game_party.gain_gold(pay)
      sword[:favor] += 1
      sword[:want] = nil
      text = "独行大侠吃得干干净净，放下#{pay}两银子：“好手艺！”"
      case sword[:favor]
      when 3
        sword[:away] = day + 20
        text += "他擦擦嘴：“过些日子我要出趟远门，回来给你带点好东西。”"
      when 6
        set_flag(:sword_friends)
        text += "“我那些江湖朋友都想尝尝你的手艺，我跟客栈打过招呼了，往后点菜的人多着呢。”（客栈的菜单报酬提高）"
      end
      text
    end
  end
end

#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 砍柴的规则
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
module WebLife
  class << self
    def axe? = AXES.key?($game_actors[1].weapon_id)
    def wood_skill = data[:skill][:wood].to_i
    def wood_level = SKILL_STEPS.count { |n| wood_skill >= n }
    def wood_title = WOOD_TITLES[wood_level]
    def forest_name(f) = FORESTS[f]

    def wood_log
      data[:wood] ||= {}
    end

    # 林情（同鱼情，用 :stock 里的另一个键）
    def forest_stock(f) = stock(:"forest_#{f}")
    def drain_forest(f, n) = drain_stock(:"forest_#{f}", n)

    # 下斧前：变量 9 = 1 可以砍 5 林子秃了
    def start_chop(forest)
      @forest = forest
      @wood_interlude = nil
      if forest_stock(forest) < 15
        $game_variables[9] = 5
        return
      end
      pool = WOODS.values.select { |w| w[:forest] == forest && w[:seasons].include?(season) }
      boost = wood_level + AXES[$game_actors[1].weapon_id][:more]
      weights = pool.map { |w| [w, RARITY[w[:rarity]] + boost * w[:rarity] * (w[:rarity] == 3 ? 0.4 : 1.5)] }
      r = rand * weights.sum { |_, x| x }
      @tree = weights.find { |_, x| (r -= x) < 0 }&.first || weights[-1][0]
      roll_wood_interlude
      $game_variables[9] = 1
    end

    def bald_text
      "#{forest_name(@forest)}的树快被你砍秃了，剩下的都是小树苗。过些日子再来吧。"
    end

    def tree_prompt
      "眼前是一棵#{@tree[:name]}的树。#{@tree[:hint]}——怎么下斧？"
    end

    # 下斧：对了多得一根。顺手采山货。返回说明
    def chop(method)
      w = @tree
      n = method == w[:cut] ? 2 : 1
      $game_party.gain_item(w[:item], n)
      wood_log[w[:item]] = (wood_log[w[:item]] || 0) + n
      data[:skill][:wood] = wood_skill + 1 + w[:rarity] * 2 + (n - 1)
      drain_forest(@forest, WOOD_STOCK_COST[w[:rarity]])
      pass_time(2)
      a = $game_actors[1]
      a.hp -= 15 if a.hp > 15
      WebMod.gain_exp(CATCH_EXP[w[:rarity]]) if CATCH_EXP[w[:rarity]] > 0
      up = train(ART_WOOD, 1 + w[:rarity])
      text = method == w[:cut] ? "下斧正好，#{w[:name]}应声而开，得到#{w[:name]}两份。" : "费了好大劲，总算砍下一截#{w[:name]}。"
      text += "（实战经验+#{CATCH_EXP[w[:rarity]]}）" if CATCH_EXP[w[:rarity]] > 0
      got = gather
      text += "顺手采到了#{got}。" unless got.empty?
      text += "一上一下之间，你对攀山步又有了新的领悟！（攀山步升到#{up}级）" if up
      text
    end

    def gather
      more = 1 + (WebGear.value(:gather_more) > 0 ? 1 : 0)
      got = GATHER.select do |item, forests, seasons, chance|
        (forests.nil? || forests.include?(@forest)) && (seasons.nil? || seasons.include?(season)) && rand(100) < chance
      end
      got.each { |item, *| $game_party.gain_item(item, more) }
      got.map { |item, *| $data_items[item].name + (more > 1 ? "×#{more}" : '') }.join('、')
    end

    # ---- 伐木时的小插曲
    WOOD_INTERLUDES = [[:boar, 6, nil], [:bees, 10, nil], [:herbalist, 10, nil], [:fog, 8, [:basin, :snow, :yunv]], [:song, 8, [:wudang, :basin]]]
    def roll_wood_interlude
      return if rand(100) >= 20
      pool = WOOD_INTERLUDES.select { |_, _, fs| fs.nil? || fs.include?(@forest) }
      r = rand(pool.sum { |_, w, _| w })
      pool.each { |k, w, _| return @wood_interlude = k if (r -= w) < 0 }
    end

    def wood_interlude = @wood_interlude

    def wood_interlude_text
      case @wood_interlude
      when :boar then '林子里一阵窸窣，一头山豹从树后蹿了出来！'
      when :bees then '树杈上挂着一个野蜂窝，嗡嗡作响。'
      when :herbalist
        $game_party.gain_item(74, 1)
        '一个背着药篓的采药人路过，送你一把草药：“这山里的参，都长在松林深处的阴坡上。”'
      when :fog
        pass_time(3)
        '山里起了大雾，你在林子里转了半天才找回原处。'
      when :song
        '远处传来一阵山歌：“丁丁伐木声，山深不见人……”唱得苍劲有力。'
      else ''
      end
    end

    def poke_bees
      a = $game_actors[1]
      lost = [a.maxhp / 10, a.hp - 1].min
      a.hp -= lost if lost > 0
      $game_party.gain_item(76, 2)
      '你一斧捅下蜂窝，被蜇了好几口，脸都肿了，好在割到两块野蜂蜜。'
    end
  end
end

# 歌樵子：武当山脚。樵技 5 级传攀山步、送开山斧；入了厨子行的，再教两道山珍菜。

# 按顺序检查条件，第一个成立的执行（多个 if / else 嵌套的简写）
first_of = lambda do |c, cases, fallback|
  cond, body = cases[0]
  return fallback.call if cond.nil?
  c.if_script(cond) { body.call }.else { first_of.call(c, cases[1..], fallback) }
end

#    护林（武）    把伐木把头打跑（入伙过黑风寨的，一句话就能让兄弟们收手）
#    护林（生活）  给商家堡管事凑三根楠木、两根檀木当梁木，他把人叫回去，还照价多给五成

#    不管          一个月后神木倒了，只剩树墩
#  护住神木的：歌樵子说出往事（绿林“铁斧”），传绝招“铁斧断岳”（34），给铁木心；拿斧头来，三天后打成铁木神斧。
#  宣花大斧：拿着斧头在山里走，可能碰上自称“老程”的黑脸大汉，接住他的三板斧，斧子归你（奇遇 29）。
#
#  编号：开关 151 伐木队在神木下、152 神木倒了；物品 82 铁木心；武器 78 宣花大斧、79 铁木神斧；绝招 34 铁斧断岳；
#        敌人 163 伐木把头、164 黑脸大汉；奇遇 29
#==========================================================================
module WebLife
  GROVE_DAYS = 30
  BEAMS = { 70 => 3, 71 => 2 }                       # 楠木三根、檀木两根
  STEWARD_BUYS = [70, 71, 73]                         # 管事收的好木料
  AXES[78] = { more: 3 }
  AXES[79] = { more: 4 }

  class << self
    def grove
      data[:grove] ||= {}
    end

    def grove_stage = grove[:stage]

    def grove_start_due?
      grove_stage.nil? && $game_variables[71] >= 1 && wood_level >= 6
    end

    def grove_start
      grove[:stage] = :crew
      grove[:day] = day
      $game_switches[151] = true
      $game_map.need_refresh = true
    end

    def grove_days_left
      [grove[:day].to_i + GROVE_DAYS - day, 0].max
    end

    # 一个月没人管，神木就倒了（进出地图时检查）
    def grove_tick
      return unless grove_stage == :crew && grove_days_left <= 0
      grove[:stage] = :fallen
      $game_switches[151] = false
      $game_switches[152] = true
    end

    def grove_end(stage, fallen: false)
      grove[:stage] = stage
      $game_switches[151] = false
      $game_switches[152] = fallen
      $game_map.need_refresh = true
    end

    def grove_protected? = %i[fought beams].include?(grove_stage)
    def grove_reward_due? = grove_protected? && !flag?(:tiefu)
    def grove_fallen_due? = grove_stage == :fallen && !flag?(:grove_mourned)

    def grove_hint
      "“黑风寨的人还在山脚锯那棵树。照他们那个锯法，再有#{grove_days_left}天就得倒。”"
    end

    def grove_praise
      if grove_stage == :beams
        '“我听说了。你拿自己砍的楠木、檀木替商家堡凑够了梁木，不动刀枪，树也保住了——比我年轻时强。”'
      else
        '“我都看见了。”歌樵子把烟袋一磕，“你一个人，把黑风寨那帮人赶下了山。”'
      end
    end

    def grove_reward
      set_flag(:tiefu)
      $game_party.gain_item(82, 1)
      study_skill
    end

    def geqiao_cold
      ['歌樵子背过身去，自顾自唱起山歌，不理你。',
       '“你走吧。山里没有你要的东西了。”',
       '歌樵子看了一眼山脚那个大树墩，又看了你一眼，什么也没说。'].sample
    end

    # ---- 护林的三种动手方式
    def grove_sell
      grove_end(:sold, fallen: true)
      $game_party.gain_gold(5000)
      pass_time(8)
      '你抄起斧头和黑风寨的人一起动手，锯了整整一天，千年神木轰然倒下，震得满山鸟飞。管事派人送来五千两银子。'
    end

    def beams_ready?
      BEAMS.all? { |id, n| $game_party.item_number(id) >= n }
    end

    def grove_beams
      pay = BEAMS.sum { |id, n| $data_items[id].price * n } * 3 / 2
      BEAMS.each { |id, n| $game_party.lose_item(id, n) }
      $game_party.gain_gold(pay)
      grove_end(:beams)
      "管事一根根验过木料，连连点头：“好料！比那棵老树还直溜。”他派人上山把黑风寨的人叫了回来。（得到#{pay}两）"
    end

    # ---- 商家堡管事：帮过他的（凑梁木、帮着砍树），以后高价收好木料
    def steward_rate
      { sold: 1.5, beams: 1.2 }[grove_stage]
    end

    def steward_buy
      rate = steward_rate
      got = STEWARD_BUYS.map { |id| [id, $game_party.item_number(id)] }.select { |_, n| n > 0 }
      if got.empty?
        more = rate == 1.5 ? '五成' : '两成'
        return "堡里还要盖后院，楠木、檀木、沉香木，有多少收多少，价钱比市面高#{more}。"
      end
      pay = got.sum { |id, n| ($data_items[id].price * n * rate).to_i }
      got.each { |id, n| $game_party.lose_item(id, n) }
      $game_party.gain_gold(pay)
      names = got.map { |id, n| "#{$data_items[id].name}#{n}根" }.join('、')
      "管事收下了#{names}，付了#{pay}两：“下回有好料，还往堡里送。”"
    end

    def tree_text
      case grove_stage
      when :crew then "树干上已经被锯出一道深口子，木屑撒了一地。再过#{grove_days_left}天，它就撑不住了。"
      when :fought, :beams then '神木枝叶繁茂。树下系着一根红布条，是歌樵子绑的。'
      when :sold, :fallen then '只剩一个大树墩，年轮密得数不清。'
      else '一棵千年古树，四五个人都合抱不过来。树皮上刻着一把小斧头的记号，已经长进了树里。'
      end
    end

    # ---- 铁木神斧：铁木心 + 一把斧头，歌樵子打三天
    def forge_offer? = $game_party.item_number(82) > 0 && !grove[:forge] && !flag?(:forged)
    def forging? = grove[:forge] && day < grove[:forge]
    def forge_ready? = grove[:forge] && day >= grove[:forge]

    def forge_axe
      [77, 76].find { |w| $game_party.weapon_number(w) > 0 }
    end

    # 本作身上拿着的兵器也算在包袱里（商店卖时才扣掉）：要是只有手上这一把，就从手上取下来
    def forge_start
      w = forge_axe
      a = $game_actors[1]
      if a.weapon_id == w && $game_party.weapon_number(w) == 1
        a.equip(0, 0)
        study_skill
      end
      $game_party.lose_weapon(w, 1)
      $game_party.lose_item(82, 1)
      grove[:forge] = day + 3
      "歌樵子接过#{$data_weapons[w].name}和铁木心，掂了掂：“三天后来取。”"
    end

    def forge_give
      grove[:forge] = nil
      set_flag(:forged)
      $game_party.gain_weapon(79, 1)
      '歌樵子从屋里拎出一柄乌沉沉的大斧：“铁木作柄，斧头回炉重打，叫它铁木神斧吧。”（得到铁木神斧）'
    end
  end
end

#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 读书的规则
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
module WebLife
  READ_INTERLUDES = [[:doze, 6], [:letter, 4], [:insight, 5], [:worm, 3], [:boy, 6]]

  class << self
    def scholar? = flag?(:scholar)
    def book_skill = data[:skill][:book].to_i
    def book_level = SKILL_STEPS.count { |n| book_skill >= n }
    def book_title = BOOK_TITLES[book_level]

    def gain_book_skill(n)
      data[:skill][:book] = book_skill + n
    end

    # 每本书读到第几章：{ 物品 => 章数 }
    def books_read
      data[:books] ||= {}
    end

    def book_done?(id) = books_read[id].to_i >= BOOKS[id][:chapters]
    def books_done = BOOKS.keys.count { |id| book_done?(id) }

    def eyes_max = EYES_PER_DAY + (WebGear.value(:read_more) > 0 ? 2 : 0)

    def eyes_used
      d, n = data[:eyes]
      d == day ? n.to_i : 0
    end

    def use_eyes
      data[:eyes] = [day, eyes_used + 1]
    end

    # 打开一本书：变量 9 = 1 读、2 眼睛酸了
    def start_read
      @book = BOOKS[$web_used_item.to_i] || BOOKS[83]
      @quiz = nil
      @read_interlude = nil
      if eyes_used >= eyes_max
        $game_variables[9] = 2
        return
      end
      roll_read_interlude
      @quiz = @book[:quiz].sample if @read_interlude.nil? && !book_done?(@book[:id]) && rand(100) < 35
      $game_variables[9] = 1
    end

    def tired_text
      "眼睛又酸又涩，字都看成了重影。今天读了#{eyes_used}章，明天再读吧。"
    end

    def roll_read_interlude
      return if rand(100) >= 20
      pool = READ_INTERLUDES.reject { |k, _| k == :boy && $game_map.map_id != 9 }
      r = rand(pool.sum { |_, w| w })
      pool.each { |k, w| return @read_interlude = k if (r -= w) < 0 }
    end

    def read_interlude = @read_interlude

    def read_interlude_text
      case @read_interlude
      when :doze
        pass_time(2)
        '读着读着，眼皮越来越沉，一头栽在书上睡着了。醒来时，口水把书页洇湿了一片。'
      when :letter
        g = 30 + rand(170)
        $game_party.gain_gold(g)
        "书页里夹着一张发黄的信笺，是哪位前人写给家里的。信里还包着#{g}两碎银子。"
      when :insight
        '读到一处，忽然豁然开朗，前面几章没想通的地方，一下子都通了。'
      when :worm
        '书页上被蠹鱼咬出一串小洞，你只好连蒙带猜地读下去。'
      when :boy
        gain_book_skill(2)
        '小书童探头进来：“这个字念什么呀？”你给他讲了半天，自己倒也温习了一遍。（学识+2）'
      else ''
      end
    end

    # 小题：选项打乱，记下对的是第几个
    def quiz? = !@quiz.nil?

    def quiz_text
      WebMod.choice_labels = @quiz[1].shuffle
      @quiz_answer = WebMod.choice_labels.index(@quiz[1][0])
      @quiz[0]
    end

    def answer(i)
      right = @quiz[1][0]
      @quiz = nil
      if i == @quiz_answer
        @quiz_bonus = true
        "对了！这一处读通了，往下读得飞快。（多读一章）"
      else
        "不对，是“#{right}”。你红着脸把这句抄了三遍。"
      end
    end

    # 读一章：涨学识、读书识字；读通了领收获。返回说明
    def read_chapter
      b = @book
      use_eyes
      pass_time(1)
      if @read_interlude == :doze
        @quiz_bonus = false
        return "这一觉睡掉了大半天，《#{b[:name]}》一页也没翻过去。"
      end
      was_done = book_done?(b[:id])
      n = 1 + (@quiz_bonus ? 1 : 0) + (@read_interlude == :insight ? 1 : 0)
      @quiz_bonus = false
      books_read[b[:id]] = [books_read[b[:id]].to_i + n, b[:chapters]].min
      gain = was_done ? 1 : n * (1 + (b[:kind] == :classic ? 1 : 0)) + ($game_map.map_id == 9 ? 1 : 0)
      gain_book_skill(gain)
      up = train_reading(n)
      text = if was_done
               "《#{b[:name]}》你早就读通了，温故而知新。（学识+#{gain}）"
             else
               "读完了《#{b[:name]}》第#{books_read[b[:id]]}章，共#{b[:chapters]}章。（学识+#{gain}）"
             end
      text += "读书识字长进了！（#{up}级）" if up
      text += book_reward(b) if !was_done && book_done?(b[:id])
      text
    end

    # 读书长读书识字：没学过、到了 100 级就不长
    def train_reading(chapters)
      return nil if $game_variables[BOOK_ART] >= BOOK_ART_CAP
      up = train(BOOK_ART, chapters * (10 + book_level * 4))
      $game_variables[BOOK_ART] = BOOK_ART_CAP if up && $game_variables[BOOK_ART] > BOOK_ART_CAP
      up && [up, BOOK_ART_CAP].min
    end

    def art_capped_note
      $game_variables[BOOK_ART] >= BOOK_ART_CAP ? '（读书识字到了一百级，书上的已经难不倒你，再往上要请教顾先生）' : ''
    end

    # ---- 读通一本书的收获
    def book_reward(b)
      gain_book_skill(5)
      kind, *args = b[:reward]
      tale_rate = WebGear.value(:tale_double) > 0 ? 2 : 1
      case kind
      when :pot
        WebMod.gain_pot(args[0] * tale_rate)
        "合上书，只觉得见识长了不少。（潜能+#{args[0] * tale_rate}）"
      when :tale
        WebMod.gain_pot(args[0] * tale_rate)
        "书里的英雄好汉、悲欢离合，看得你如同亲身走了一遭。（江湖阅历，潜能+#{args[0] * tale_rate}）"
      when :moral
        WebMod.gain_morality(args[0])
        WebMod.gain_pot(args[1])
        "圣贤的话一句句记在心里，做人做事更有分寸了。（道德+#{args[0]}，潜能+#{args[1]}）"
      when :poem
        WebMod.gain_pot(args[0])
        "诗三百，一言以蔽之，思无邪。往后有人请你写情书，你也写得出来了。（潜能+#{args[0]}）"
      when :wit
        $game_variables[13] += 1
        '读通了易经，看什么都多了一层变化。（悟性+1）'
      when :exp
        WebMod.gain_exp(args[0])
        "合上书，觉得自己能打十个——其实未必，不过招式里的进退确实多了些讲究。（实战经验+#{args[0]}）"
      when :fisher_woodman
        data[:skill][:fishing] = data[:skill][:fishing].to_i + 15
        data[:skill][:wood] = data[:skill][:wood].to_i + 15
        '渔者识鱼性，樵者知木理。读完了，钓鱼砍柴都有了新的心得。（渔技、樵技各+15）'
      when :cook_book
        data[:skill][:cooking] = data[:skill][:cooking].to_i + 20
        '书里讲的做酱、腌菜、炙肉的法子，都是老祖宗的手艺。（厨艺+20）'
      when :herb
        '一草一木的药性都记下了。往后采到的草药，自己就会用了。（草药可以在物品栏里服用，回气血）'
      when :go
        WebMod.gain_pot(150)
        tip = $game_switches[106] ? '' : '书里有一句“欲取先予，置之死地而后生”，你忽然想起西郊那盘怪棋。'
        "#{tip}（潜能+150）"
      when :rumor
        rumor_from_book
      else ''
      end
    end

    # 山海经：书页边上有人用小字批注着一条江湖传闻（第一条还没听过的）
    def rumor_from_book
      sw, _, rumor = RUMORS.find { |s, cond, _| !$game_switches[s] && eval(cond.is_a?(String) ? cond : 'false') }
      return '书页边上密密麻麻写满了批注，可惜都是些你已经知道的事。' unless sw
      $game_switches[sw] = true
      "书页边上有人用小字批注：#{rumor}"
    end
  end
end

class Scene_BookList
  def main
    @page = 0
    @kinds = WebLife::BOOK_KINDS.keys
    @window = Window_Base.new(0, 0, 640, 480)
    @window.contents = Bitmap.new(608, 448)
    refresh
    Graphics.transition
    loop do
      Graphics.update
      Input.update
      break if Input.trigger?(Input::B) || Input.trigger?(Input::C)
      if Input.trigger?(Input::RIGHT) || Input.trigger?(Input::LEFT)
        @page = (@page + (Input.trigger?(Input::RIGHT) ? 1 : -1)) % @kinds.size
        $game_system.se_play($data_system.cursor_se)
        refresh
      end
    end
    $game_system.se_play($data_system.cancel_se)
    $scene = Scene_Map.new
    Graphics.freeze
    @window.dispose
  end

  # 一页一类：书名、读到第几章；没见过的书显示“？？？”
  def refresh
    c = @window.contents
    c.clear
    c.font.color.set(0, 0, 0)
    l = WebLife
    kind = @kinds[@page]
    c.font.size = 22
    c.draw_text(0, 0, 608, 28, "书目　#{l.rank_name ? l.rank_name + '　' : ''}#{l.book_title || '识字'}（学识#{l.book_level}级）　读通#{l.books_done}/#{l::BOOKS.size}本　今天还能读#{[l.eyes_max - l.eyes_used, 0].max}章", 1)
    c.font.size = 20
    c.draw_text(0, 40, 608, 28, "← #{l::BOOK_KINDS[kind]}（#{@page + 1}/#{@kinds.size}） →", 1)
    c.font.size = 18
    l::BOOKS.values.select { |b| b[:kind] == kind }.each_with_index do |b, i|
      y = 84 + i * 32
      read = l.books_read[b[:id]].to_i
      if read > 0 || $game_party.item_number(b[:id]) > 0
        c.draw_text(40, y, 200, 28, "《#{b[:name]}》")
        c.draw_text(260, y, 160, 28, l.book_done?(b[:id]) ? '读通了' : "#{read}/#{b[:chapters]}章")
      else
        c.draw_text(40, y, 200, 28, '？？？')
      end
    end
    c.font.size = 16
    c.draw_text(0, 424, 608, 24, '左右键翻页，确定或取消返回', 1)
  end
end

    def start_write
      if writes_today >= WRITES_PER_DAY
        $game_variables[9] = 2
        return
      end
      data[:writes] = [day, writes_today + 1]
      if wang[:favor] < WANG_LETTERS && rand(100) < 35
        @writ = [:wang, '家书', nil, '开头怎么写？', %w[吾儿知悉 父母亲大人膝下 足下], 50, nil]
      else
        pool = WRITS.select do |*, cond|
          cond.nil? || (cond == :winter && season == 3) || (cond == :poem && book_done?(87))
        end
        @writ = pool.sample
      end
      $game_variables[9] = 1
    end

    def no_client_text
      '今天来写信的人都打发走了，砚台也干了。明天再来吧。'
    end

    def client_text
      return @writ[2] unless @writ[0] == :wang
      n = wang[:favor] + 1
      "王大娘又来了，手里攥着一包碎银子：“先生，再给我儿写封信。他在边关当兵，这是第#{n}封了……”"
    end

    def writ_question
      WebMod.choice_labels = @writ[4].shuffle
      @writ_answer = WebMod.choice_labels.index(@writ[4][0])
      @writ[3]
    end

    def write(i)
      key, kind, _, _, words, base = @writ
      right = i == @writ_answer
      pay = (base * (1 + book_level * 0.15) * (right ? 1 : 0.4) * (1 + WebGear.value(:write_pay)) * rank_rate).to_i
      $game_party.gain_gold(pay)
      gain_book_skill(right ? 3 : 1)
      data[:writ_total] = data[:writ_total].to_i + 1
      pass_time(2)
      up = train(BRUSH_ART, right ? 3 : 1)
      text = right ? "#{kind}写好了，客人捧着看了又看，连声道谢，付了#{pay}两。" : "客人看了直皱眉：“这……怎么是这么写的？”只给了#{pay}两。（该写“#{words[0]}”）"
      text += "笔锋一转之间，你对一阳书指又有了新的领悟！（#{up}级）" if up
      text += wang_progress if key == :wang
      text
    end

    # 王大娘的信：写满五封，儿子回来了
    def wang_progress
      wang[:favor] += 1
      case wang[:favor]
      when 2 then '王大娘抹着眼泪：“他回信了，说边关冷，让我别惦记。”'
      when 4 then '王大娘笑得合不拢嘴：“他说打了胜仗，过些日子就能回来了！”'
      when WANG_LETTERS
        $game_party.gain_armor(117, 1)
        '没过几天，一个晒得黝黑的后生找到代书桌前：“您就是给我娘写信的先生？这些年多亏了您。”' \
          '他解下腰间一块玉佩塞给你：“这是我在边关立功得的，您收下。”（得到玉佩）'
      else ''
      end
    end
  end
end

#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 功名、禁书、笔阵图的规则
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
module WebLife
  class << self
    # ---- 功名
    def rank = data[:rank].to_i
    def rank_name = RANKS[rank]
    def rank_rate = [1, 1.3, 1.6][rank]
    def year = ticks / 3000

    def exam_kind = rank == 0 ? '县试' : '乡试'
    def exam_fee = rank == 0 ? 100 : 500
    def exam_need = rank == 0 ? 3 : (flag?(:recommend) ? 3 : 4)

    def exam_ready?
      rank < 2 && book_level >= (rank == 0 ? 3 : 7)
    end

    def exam_open?
      exam_ready? && season == 2 && data[:exam_year] != year
    end

    def exam_info
      return '“举人老爷，今年的廪银可领过了？”师爷满脸堆笑。' if rank == 2
      need = rank == 0 ? 3 : 7
      return "“#{exam_kind}要学问扎实的人去考，学识#{need}级再来吧。”" unless exam_ready?
      return '“今年的秋闱你已经考过了，明年秋天再来。”' if data[:exam_year] == year
      "“#{exam_kind}每年秋天开考，到时候来报名，报名费#{exam_fee}两。”"
    end

    def exam_pool
      base = BOOKS.values.select { |b| b[:kind] == :classic }.flat_map { |b| b[:quiz] }
      rank == 0 ? base : POLICY + BOOKS[88][:quiz] + BOOKS[89][:quiz] + BOOKS[104][:quiz]
    end

    def exam_begin
      $game_party.lose_gold(exam_fee)
      data[:exam_year] = year
      @exam = exam_pool.sample(5)
      @exam_right = 0
      @exam_i = 0
    end

    def exam_question
      q = @exam[@exam_i]
      WebMod.choice_labels = q[1].shuffle
      @exam_answer = WebMod.choice_labels.index(q[1][0])
      "第#{@exam_i + 1}题：#{q[0]}"
    end

    def exam_answer(i)
      @exam_right += 1 if i == @exam_answer
      @exam_i += 1
    end

    def exam_result
      pass_time(8)
      if @exam_right >= exam_need
        data[:rank] = rank + 1
        gain_book_skill(10)
        data[:stipend] = season_index if rank == 2
        "五题答对#{@exam_right}题。放榜那天，榜上赫然写着你的名字——你中了#{rank_name}！" \
          "#{rank == 1 ? '（代写报酬提高三成）' : '（代写报酬提高六成，每季可到师爷那儿领三百两廪银）'}"
      else
        "五题只答对#{@exam_right}题，要对#{exam_need}题才行。放榜那天，你在榜上从头找到尾……名落孙山。明年再来吧。"
      end
    end

    def season_index = ticks / 750

    def stipend_due? = rank == 2 && data[:stipend].to_i < season_index

    def take_stipend
      n = season_index - data[:stipend].to_i
      data[:stipend] = season_index
      $game_party.gain_gold(300 * n)
      "师爷点出#{300 * n}两廪银：“举人老爷收好。”"
    end

    # ---- 禁书
    def ban
      data[:ban] ||= {}
    end

    def ban_stage = ban[:stage]

    def ban_due?
      ban_stage.nil? && book_level >= 5 && books_done >= 6 && !$game_switches[153]
    end

    def ban_start
      ban[:stage] = :search
      ban[:day] = day
    end

    def ban_days_left = [ban[:day].to_i + BAN_DAYS - day, 0].max

    def ban_hint
      "顾先生压低声音：“书稿的事……刘师爷说#{ban_days_left}天后来搜。”"
    end

    def ban_carry
      ban[:stage] = :carry
      $game_party.gain_item(103, 1)
    end

    def ban_copy
      ban[:stage] = :copied
      ban[:copied] = true
      pass_time(16)
      $game_party.gain_item(104, 1)
      "你在书房里点着灯，整整抄了两天两夜，手腕都抄肿了。（得到日知录）顾先生翻着你的抄本，眼圈红了：“好，好……书在人间，就烧不掉了。”"
    end

    def ban_inform
      ban[:stage] = :informed
      take_away
      $game_party.gain_gold(2000)
      $game_variables[164] = 0
      WebMod.gain_morality(-10)
      text = '刘师爷眼睛一亮，当即带着捕快去了私塾。不一会儿，顾先生就被押着走过了街口。师爷赏了你两千两，还把你案底上的事一笔勾销了。（通缉值清零，道德−10）'
      text += '周铁总捕听说后，也托人捎来一句“办得好”。' if $game_switches[117]
      text
    end

    def take_away
      $game_switches[153] = true
      ban[:back] = day + AWAY_DAYS
      $game_map.need_refresh = true
    end

    # 搜身：交出书稿，等于书稿落到官府手里
    def ban_seized
      $game_party.lose_item(103, $game_party.item_number(103))
      ban[:stage] = :seized
      take_away
    end

    # 进出地图时检查：到期搜查；先生被带走一个月后回来
    def ban_tick
      if %i[search carry copied].include?(ban_stage) && ban_days_left <= 0
        case ban_stage
        when :search then ban[:stage] = :ignored; take_away
        when :carry then ban[:stage] = :searched
        when :copied then ban[:stage] = :spread
        end
      end
      if $game_switches[153] && ban[:back] && day >= ban[:back]
        $game_switches[153] = false
        ban[:back] = nil
      end
    end

    def ban_reward_due?
      (ban_stage == :searched && $game_party.item_number(103) > 0) || (ban_stage == :spread && !flag?(:lituo))
    end

    def ban_reward
      text = if ban_stage == :searched
               $game_party.lose_item(103, 1)
               ban[:stage] = :hidden
               set_flag(:recommend)
               '顾先生接过书稿，摩挲了半天：“官府翻遍了私塾，一个字也没找到。多亏了你。”他另写了一封荐书：“去考乡试，带上它。”'
             else
               '顾先生笑道：“原稿我烧了，官府扑了个空。可书已经在外头传开了——这把火，是他们烧不灭的。”'
             end
      set_flag(:lituo)
      study_skill
      note = $game_variables[BRUSH_ART] > 0 ? '' : '先生又叮嘱：“这一招要会一阳书指才使得出，代写多了，我送你一本笔阵图。”'
      "#{text}#{note}（学会了“力透纸背”：一阳书指 120 级、基本拳脚 120 级可用）"
    end

    def ban_ended_line
      case ban_stage
      when :informed then '书童躲着你，小声嘀咕：“就是他……”'
      when :ignored, :seized then '书童红着眼睛：“先生的书稿被官府搜走烧了……”'
      else ''
      end
    end

    # ---- 笔阵图：代写满十五回，顾先生送
    def brush_due? = scholar? && data[:writ_total].to_i >= BRUSH_WRITS && !flag?(:brush) && !$game_switches[153] && ban_stage != :informed

    def give_brush
      set_flag(:brush)
      $game_party.gain_item(105, 1)
    end
  end

#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 采药的规则
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
module WebLife
  class << self
    def medic? = flag?(:medic)
    def hoe? = HOES.include?($game_actors[1].weapon_id)
    def medic_skill = data[:skill][:medic].to_i
    def medic_level = SKILL_STEPS.count { |n| medic_skill >= n }
    def medic_title = MEDIC_TITLES[medic_level]

    def gain_medic(n)
      data[:skill][:medic] = medic_skill + n
    end

    def herb_stock(p) = stock(:"herb_#{p}")

    # 气血上限的满值（原版金创药、运功疗伤的算法）
    def full_hp
      100 + $game_variables[24] / 4 + [($game_variables[157] - 14) * 20, 300].min
    end

    # 下锄前：变量 9 = 1 可以挖、5 挖空了
    def start_dig(place)
      @herb_place = place
      @herb_interlude = nil
      if herb_stock(place) < 15
        $game_variables[9] = 5
        return
      end
      pool = HERBS.values.select { |h| h[:place] == place && h[:seasons].include?(season) }
      weights = pool.map { |h| [h, RARITY[h[:rarity]] + medic_level * h[:rarity] * (h[:rarity] == 3 ? 0.3 : 1.2)] }
      r = rand * weights.sum { |_, x| x }
      @herb = weights.find { |_, x| (r -= x) < 0 }&.first || weights[-1][0]
      roll_herb_interlude
      $game_variables[9] = 1
    end

    def dug_out_text
      "#{HERB_PLACES[@herb_place]}这一片的药草被挖得差不多了，过些日子再来吧。"
    end

    def herb_prompt
      name = $data_items[@herb[:item]].name
      known = book_done?(92) ? "（本草纲目上说：该#{DIG[@herb[:dig]]}）" : ''
      "是一株#{name}。#{@herb[:hint]}#{known}——怎么挖？"
    end

    def dig(method)
      h = @herb
      right = method == h[:dig] || book_done?(92) && rand(100) < 50
      n = (right ? 2 : 1) + (WebGear.value(:herb_more) > 0 ? 1 : 0)
      $game_party.gain_item(h[:item], n)
      gain_medic(1 + h[:rarity] * 2 + (right ? 1 : 0))
      drain_stock(:"herb_#{@herb_place}", HERB_STOCK_COST[h[:rarity]])
      pass_time(2)
      WebMod.gain_exp(CATCH_EXP[h[:rarity]]) if CATCH_EXP[h[:rarity]] > 0
      up = train_medic(1 + h[:rarity])
      name = $data_items[h[:item]].name
      text = right ? "挖得干干净净，得到#{name}#{n}份。" : "挖坏了一些，只剩下#{name}#{n}份能用。"
      text += "（实战经验+#{CATCH_EXP[h[:rarity]]}）" if CATCH_EXP[h[:rarity]] > 0
      text + (up ? "一俯一仰之间，你对青囊功又有了新的领悟！（#{up}级）" : '')
    end

    # 青囊功（第二批）：学过才长
    def train_medic(times)
      $game_variables[MEDIC_ART].to_i > 0 ? train(MEDIC_ART, times) : nil
    end

    # ---- 采药的小插曲
    HERB_INTERLUDES = [[:snake, 8], [:cliff, 6], [:picker, 8], [:lost, 6]]
    def roll_herb_interlude
      return if rand(100) >= 20
      r = rand(HERB_INTERLUDES.sum { |_, w| w })
      HERB_INTERLUDES.each { |k, w| return @herb_interlude = k if (r -= w) < 0 }
    end

    def herb_interlude = @herb_interlude

    def herb_interlude_text
      case @herb_interlude
      when :snake then '草丛里“嘶”的一声，一条花斑毒蛇昂起了头！'
      when :cliff then '抬头一看，悬崖半腰的朽木上长着一朵紫红的灵芝。'
      when :picker
        $game_party.gain_item(106, 1)
        '一个背着药篓的老药农路过，送你一把甘草：“挖药别贪多，给山里留点种。”'
      when :lost
        pass_time(3)
        '山里的路七拐八绕，你转了半天才找回原处。'
      else ''
      end
    end

    # 攀崖采灵芝：六成拿到，否则摔下来——受伤（压低气血上限）
    def climb_cliff
      if rand(100) < 60 + medic_level * 2
        $game_party.gain_item(113, 1)
        return '你手脚并用攀上崖壁，小心地把灵芝割了下来。（得到灵芝）'
      end
      a = $game_actors[1]
      hurt = [full_hp / 10, a.maxhp - 1].min
      a.maxhp -= hurt
      a.hp = [a.hp, a.maxhp].min
      "脚下一滑，你从崖壁上摔了下来，摔得浑身是伤。（受伤：气血上限−#{hurt}）"
    end
  end
end

module WebLife
  class << self
    def med_known?(id) = medic? && medic_level >= MEDS[id][:level]
    def med_ids = MEDS.keys.select { |id| med_known?(id) }

    def can_brew?(id)
      MEDS[id][:needs].all? { |item, n| $game_party.item_number(item) >= n }
    end

    def med_needs_text(id)
      MEDS[id][:needs].map { |item, n| "#{$data_items[item].name}×#{n}（有#{$game_party.item_number(item)}）" }.join('、')
    end

    # 配一味药：返回 [品质 0～2, 份数, 说明]（判断同做菜）
    def brew(id, prep, heat)
      m = MEDS[id]
      m[:needs].each { |item, n| $game_party.lose_item(item, n) }
      q = (prep == m[:prep] ? 1 : 0) + (heat == m[:heat] ? 1 : 0)
      q += 1 if q < 2 && rand(100) < medic_level * 4
      n = q == 2 ? 2 : 1
      $game_party.gain_item(id, n)
      gain_medic(1 + q)
      pass_time(2)
      up = train_medic(1 + q)
      tips = ["炮制#{prep == m[:prep] ? '得法' : '不太对'}", "火候#{heat == m[:heat] ? '正好' : '不太对'}"]
      text = "#{$data_items[id].name}配好了！成色：#{QUALITY[q]}（#{tips.join('，')}），得到#{n}份。"
      text += "（青囊功升到#{up}级）" if up
      [q, n, text]
    end

    # 治伤：恢复被打掉的气血上限（同原版金创药的算法）
    def heal_injury(ratio)
      a = $game_actors[1]
      full = full_hp
      return '你身上没有伤，这药白敷了。' if a.maxhp >= full
      a.maxhp = [a.maxhp + (full * ratio).to_i, full].min
      a.hp = [a.hp + (full * ratio).to_i, a.maxhp].min
      a.maxhp >= full ? '药力化开，伤全好了。' : "药力化开，伤好了一些。（气血上限#{a.maxhp}/#{full}）"
    end

    def injured? = $game_actors[1].maxhp < full_hp
  end
end
